tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /sa gsum gyi bla ma chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po che'i gsung rab rgyal bu 'ji 'big de mur la gtam du bya ba nor bu'i 'phreng ba'i rnam par
༄༅/ /sa gsum gyi bla ma chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po che'i gsung rab rgyal bu 'ji 'big de mur la gtam du bya ba nor bu'i 'phreng ba'i rnam par

tei:bibl.tei:idno: GuruLamaWorks/Precious-and-Rare-Disk-01-20130424/rtfs/4_AMAI/AMAI033_'phags pa rin po che'i rgyal bu 'ji 'big de mur la gtam du bya ba nor bu'i phreng ba'i rnam .rtf

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /sa gsum gyi bla ma chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po che'i gsung rab rgyal bu 'ji 'big de mur la gtam du bya ba nor bu'i 'phreng ba'i rnam par bshad pa 'phags pa dgyes pa'i lha'i rol mo dpyod ldan yid 'phrog 'phrin las kun khyab ces bya ba bzhugs so// rgya gar skad du/ shrīḥdharma swā mi sarba dz+nyā mañdzu gho ṣa ar+ya ma ti dh+wa dza ye na maḥbhu mi paṇ+ḍu ka shākya u pa sa ka wa gin+d+ra a nan+da na maḥ bod skad du/ dpal chos kyi rje thams cad mkhyen pa 'jam pa'i dbyangs 'phags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan la bdag sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen ngag dang kun dga' bsod nams phyag 'tshal lo/ /spangs rtogs mthar phyin don gnyis lhun grub shākya'i tog /de gsung lung dang rtogs pa'i bdag nyid dam pa'i chos/ /rgyal sras bstan 'dzin dge 'dun 'dus pa'i tshogs rnams la/ /deng nas bzung ste byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi/ /rkang gnyis gtso bos zhabs kyis bcags pa'i gnas/ /'phags yul bstan pa gsal mdzad mkhas grub dbang / /rim par byon pa'i skyes chen de dag la/ /ngo mtshar rnam thar dran pas phyag bgyi 'o/ /gangs ri'i ljongs 'dir bshad sgrub phyogs re ba'i/ /bstan pa gsal mdzad ji snyed byon rnams dang / /yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i bdag po sa skya pa/ /yab sras brgyud par bcas la bdag cag dad/ /khyod ni zas gtsang sras po ma lags zas gtsang sras dang rnam dbyer med/ /khyod ni zur phud lnga pa ma lags zur phud lnga pa mi yi zol/ /khyod ni 'khor lo bsgyur ba ma lags 'khor lo bsgyur ba'i dpal 'byor mtshungs/ /khyod ni 'phags pa ma lags gsungs kyang 'phags pa mchog gyur khyod gcig bsngags/ /gang gi bstan pa'i rgyun bzang skyongs mdzad pa'i/ /shar nub gung gsum slob rgyun bgrangs yas dang / /phyis dus chos grwa so so 'debs mdzad pa'i/ /bshes gnyen mchog rnams bka' drin dran pas 'dud/ /khyad par snyigs dus bstan pa'i nyi ma che/

/sngags 'chang bla ma kun dga' rin chen dang / /gang gi rigs sras bsod mas dbang po'i zhabs/ /grags pa blo gros rnams gsum spyi bos mchod/ /gzhan yang rgyal ba kun gyi spyi gzugs mchog /rigs kun khyab bdag mus pa chen po sogs/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams la gus btud nas/ /gsung rab mchog gi rnam bshad 'chad la spro/ /'di ni 'phags pa mnyes pa'i lha'i rol mo/ /'di ni dpyod ldan kun gyi yid 'phrog ste/ /'di ni 'phrin las kun du khyab pa'i phyir/ /'di ni ming don ldan pa'i bstan bcos yin/ /de phyir kho bo'i rjes 'jug blo gsal rnams/ /snyoms las ma byed legs bshad ri mor bris/ /thos dang bsam pa'i yul du nges byas nas/ /mkhas mang dgyes pa'i bshad pa'i dga' ston spel/ /de la 'dir srid pa gsum gyi bla ma chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po che'i gsung rab rgyal bu 'ji 'big de mur la gtam du bya ba nor bu'i 'phreng ba 'di 'chad pa la don gsum ste/ rtsom pa po'i sku che ba'i yon tan mdo tsam bstan pa/ des mdzad pa'i bstan bcos kyi don dngos bshad pa/ rtsom pa mthar phyin pa mjug gi bya ba dang gsum las/ dang po ni skyes chen dam pa 'di gang las 'khrungs pa'i rigs ni/ byang phyogs kyi rgyud 'dir 'gran zla dang bral ba'i lha rigs 'khon sa skya pa zhes mtshan mchog gsum dang ldan pa'i gdung rigs dri ma med pa/ thub dbang gnyis pa sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta'i sku'i gcung yab zangs tsha bsod nams rgyal mtshan dang / yum yul mdog gi tsha sna'i 'dabs pha ming zung khang gi rgya mtsho zhang rgyal ba dpal/ ming ma cig kun skyid/ de la sras 'gro ba'i mgon po chos rgyal 'phags pa/ yab dgung lo nga gnyis bzhes pa shing mo lug gi lo zla ba gsum pa'i tshes drug la/ g.yas ru ngam rings kyi klu khung du sku 'khrungs/ yum gyi lhums su zhugs pa dang / bltams pa'i dus su/ ngo mtshar gyi ltas dang bcas shing /

chung ngu nas 'bri klog la sogs pa rig pa'i gnas lnga 'ga' zhig ma bslabs par mkhyen/ 'ga' zhig dka' tshegs med par mkhyen/ sngon gyi gnas dran pa'i mngon shes kyang mnga' ste 'di'i snga ma'i skye ba/ spyan ras gzigs dang gsung gleng mdzad par grags pa'i sa ston ri par yin pas/ de brtag pa'i phyir du/ sa ston ri pa'i slob ma gnyis kyis bltar 'ongs pa dang / bla ma 'di byis pa'i khrod na/ rtse zhing bzhugs pas mkhyen nas/ khyed 'ongs sam gsungs pas/ khong gnyis pos/ /khyed kyis ngo mkhyen nam zhus pas shes te/ nga'i slob ma 'di dang 'di'o zhes gsungs pas dad nas lus thams cad kyis 'dud par gyur to/ /de nas re zhig na chos rje'i phyag phyir skyid grong du byon pa'i tshe/ gla ri pa'i dge 'dun rnams kyis mjal ba dang / btsun pa bgres po cig la nga'i nye gnas bkra shis don grub byung gsungs pas/ des kyang bla mar shes zhabs la 'jus te/ mchi ma phyung ngo zhes grags so/ /de nas dgung lo gsum pa la sgrub thabs mtsho skyes la sogs thugs las gsungs pas kun gyi ya mtshan du 'dzin te/ 'di ni nges par 'phags pa'o zhes phyogs kun du grags pas/ de phyin chad 'phags pa zhes mtshan yongs su grags so/ /brgyad pa la skyes rabs thugs las gsungs/ dgu pa la chos rje pa'i sngon 'gro'i chos 'khor mdzad dus brtag gnyis gsungs/ tshogs kyi gtam bshad mdzad pas/ thams cad ngo mtshar te mkhas pa thams cad kyi nga rgyal bcag cing / snyan pas khyab par mdzad par gyur te/ bcu pa la rje'i phyag phyir byang ngos su byon pa'i lam du/ dbus su chos rje pas mkhan po/ zul phu ba'i nam za 'phred gsol gyis slob dpon mdzad nas rab tu byung / skyor mo lung pa'i mkhan po shes rab seṅge la dge tshul gyi bslab bya gsan/ de nas bcu bdun pa la/ chos rjes la mnga' ba'i yon tan thams cad rdzogs pas/ chos rje pa thugs shin du mnyes te/

bstan pa'i khur bzod par dgongs nas chos dung dang lhung bzed la sogs pa gnang / slob ma'i tshogs rnams gtad nas bstan pa'i bya ba dang / sems can mang po'i don bya ba'i dus la bab pas/ sngon gyi dam bcas pa dran par gyis shig ces pa'i sgo nas bstan pa gtad do/ /de nas glang lo la se chen gan gyis gdan drangs pa nas pho brang du byon te/ rgyal pos gzhan gyis dris pa'i lan ma thebs pa'i the tshom mang po dris pa'i lan rgyu mtshan dang bcas pa gsungs pas mnyes pa yin te/ de yang rgyal pos zhus pa'i ngor/ rgyal po nyid kyi thog drangs pa'i mi nyi shu rtsa lnga la/ kye rdo rje'i dbang bskur nas/ hor gyi yul du rdo rje theg pa'i dbu brnyes so/ /de yang mu tig 'ja' sa na/ bla ma chos kyi rje 'di phyogs su byon pa nged rang dngos su ma mjal na'ang / bla ma 'phags pa dang mjal nas/ las rgyu 'bras dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi che ba dang / /sems bskyed la sogs chos mang po thos shing / /nged hor bstan pa med pa'i sa phyogs su/ /dkon mchog gsum thos su bcug nas bstan pa la dad par byas pa de sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden par song na/ nged hor 'di tsho la sangs rgyas kyi sa bon btab pa yin pas/ chos rje khu dbon shin tu bka' drin che ba yin/ khyed dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams kyis kyang go bar bya ba'i don du/ mchod rdzas 'di phul ba yin pas/ khyed rnams kyis mi g.yel bar bshad nyan la 'bad pa gyis/ bzlas nas bskur ba yin zhes pa ltar/ skad rigs mi gcig pa du ma chos kyi brda dang tha snyad du ma gsal bar mdzad de/ slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis/ /rgyal po khri srong lde btsan la ma 'ongs pa lung bstan pa las/ lo tsā ba ka ba dpal brtsegs khyed/ /dkar nag brgyad du 'gro don byed/ /de nas u rgyan gha na ru/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar mngon du mdzad do/ /de'i phyi lo rgyal po ljang yul du dmag la phyin dus/

bla ma pa byang ngos su byon te/ chos rje pa'i sku 'bum la rab gnas mdzad/ dbus gtsang du byon te/ chos rje pa'i gsung bzhin du 'u yug pa la bsnyen rdzogs zhu ba dang / sngar ma gsan pa'i chos gsan par dgongs nas/ mdo khams bar byon pa dang / 'u yug pa glang lo la sku gshegs zhes phyogs kyi 'grul pa las thos nas phyir log ste/ rgyal po tshur byon pa dang lhan cig rgya yul du byon nas/ rgya dang hor yul gyi mtshams the le zhes bya bar chu bo chen po'i 'gram/ 'u thor/ dgung lo nyer gcig pa shing mo yos kyi lo zla ba lnga pa'i tshes bcwo lnga'i nyin/ mkhan po snye thang pa grags pa seṅge/ slob dpon jo gdan byang pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ gsang ste ba yar lung pa byang chub rgyal mtshan/ dad dge chos rje bu rgan/ mang ra ba mkhan po spro dang / gnam phar ba tshul rin la sogs pa nyi shu'i dbus su bsnyen par rdzogs nas mkhan po las phar phyin tshig gsal sogs dang / slob dpon las so thar mdo rtsa sogs dang / gsang ston las sde bdun la sogs pa mang du gsan te dpyis phyin par mdzad/ nyer gsum la ldong gdan drangs nas rtse lngar byon te/ gshin rje gshed/ gdan bzhi/ mahā ma ya/ rdor dbyings/ dus 'khor sogs rgyud 'grel pa cha lag dang bcas pa gsan/ gzhan yang rigs tshogs/ bstod tshogs/ mngon pa sogs mang du gsan no/ /lo de nyid kyi zla ba bzhi pa'i tshes bcu gsum gyi mtshan mo/ /chos rje gsal bar byon nas/ khyod 'di nas bzung ste lo 'bum phrag gcig dang stong 'das pa'i rjes su phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob zhes lung bstan zhing dbugs dbyung ba'i rjes su/ srid par sdug bsngal du ma yi/ /yun ring dus su dub pa dag /legs par gsung ba'i dbugs 'byin pa/ /thugs rje'i dbang phyug mkhyen pa'i gtso/ /chos kyi rje la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces bstod pa mdzad ces gsung / de nas rgyal po'i pho brang du byon nas/

chos 'khor bskor ba'i tshe/ tha shang la gyin zhes pa'i rjes su 'brangs ba'i zin shing gi rab byung mang po yod pa lta ba ngan pa la zhen pa dag rang gzhan la gnod par gzigs nas/ rgyal po'i bkas bskul te/ zin shing gi ston pa ring du sbyangs pa rang gi gzhung lugs mthar son pa bcu bdun rig pas pham par mdzad nas rab tu byung ste/ yang dag pa'i lta ba 'dzin du bcug go /de nas dgung lo nyer brgyad pa'i dus su/ yar cha rkyen mang du bskur nas/ dpon chen shākya bzang pos dbu rtse rnying ma'i nub tu gser thog chen mo bzhengs/ de nas so gcig pa shing mo glang gi lo la dpal ldan sa skyar phebs/ gser thog chen mor rdor dbyings kyi lha tshogs bzhugs pa'i bkra shis sgo mang rin po che du mas brgyan pa dang / rje btsun gong ma rnams kyi phyi rten sku 'bum bdun la/ gdug chos 'khor zangs gser las grub pa dang / /khyad par sku 'bum la gser thog rnams mdzad/ /mdo rgyud/ sher phyogs sogs rgyal ba'i bka'/ gser gyi po ti nyis brgya lhag pa bzhengs/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rgya chen bskor nas 'gro ba mang po smin grol gyi lam la bkod/ bdag nyid chen po 'di nyid thos pa mthar phyin nas chos kyi mnga' bdag yin yang / nga rgyal med cing chos ma gus pa bstan pa'i phyir/ chos kyi don du bshes gnyen du ma bsten te/ kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po shrī ta thā ga ta bha tra/ bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa glo bo lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen dang / snar thang pa'i mkhan po mchims nam mkha' grags dang / gsang ba gnyan 'od srung mgon po dang / grub thob chen mo che ras par grags pa slob dpon yon tan dpal/ sgyer phu ba tshogs sgom kun dga' dpal/ zhang zhung pa rdo rje 'od zer dang / rin po che skyobs pa dpal dang / rong dben dmar ba rnal 'byor dbang phyug rga lo dang / chag lots+tsha ba'i dbon po nyi ma dpal dang / dbye pa zhang mngon pa sa rin chen rdo rje dang /

brag phug pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'bum pa 'od zer dang / mdog blo ba 'dul 'dzin shākya byang chub dang / rong pa mkhan po seṅge zil gnon dang / chos rje'i slob ma mngon pa dbang phyug brtson 'grus dang / rong ri lung phug pa'i sngags pa chos kyi mgon po dang / rdzil phu ba'i dge bshes stag ston shes rab 'od zer dang / dbus sde pa slob dpon sangs rgyas 'bum dang / dge bshes bras khud pa dang / lha rje dar ma seṅge la sogs mang du bsten nas/ 'ga' zhig la theg pa chung ngu / 'ga' zhig la theg pa chen po phar phyin/ 'ga' zhig gsang sngags/ mdor na rig pa'i gnas lnga/ sde snod gsum/ rgyud sde bzhi dang 'brel ba'i bstan bcos/ mdo rgyud dbang byin rlabs/ man ngag cha lag dang bcas pa bod na yod pa phal che ba gsan pa yin no/ /de ltar dam pa'i chos gsan pa'i ched du dka' ba dpag tu med pa mdzad pa ni/ sangs rgyas bstan pa mi nub par gyur cig snyam du dgongs nas/ gzhan don 'ba' zhig gi phyir mdzad pa yin no/ /de nas dgung lo sum cu rtsa gsum pa me mo yos la/ rgyal po chen pos gdan 'dren gyi gser yig pa nan che bas gong la phebs/ de'i dus su las tshan bcu gsum gyi sgrigs mdzad nas byon pas/ bcom ldan ral gris/ sangs rgyas bstan pa bka' phyag sprin gyis bsgribs/ sems can bde skyid mi dpon lag tu shor/ /snyigs dus dge sbyong dpon po'i cha lugs 'dzin/ /'di gsum ma gtogs 'phags pa min par go /zhes zur za'i tshig phul ba la/ chos kyi rgyal po nyid kyis de'i lan du/ /bstan la 'phel 'grib 'byung bar rgyal bas gsungs/ /sems can bde skyid rang rang las la rag /gang la gang 'dul de la der ston byed/ /'di gsum ma gtogs mkhas pa min par go /zhes gsungs zhes grags so/ /de la las tshan bcu gsum ni/ gsum tshan gsum dang gnyis tshan gnyis zhes bya ste/ de la gsum tshan gsum ni/ gsol gzim mchod gsum/

'jal yig mdzod gsum/ thabs 'dren gdan gsum/ gnyis tshan gnyis ni/ skya rta gnyis/ mdzo khyi gnyis zhes grags so/ /ding sang ni rang rang gi blos btags pa'i bgrong lugs mi 'dra ba rab tu mang ngo / /de nas dgung lo so bzhi pa sa pho 'brug gi lo la/ bla ma chen po'i zhal lta ltar/ /dpon chen shākya bzang pos lha khang chen mo 'grams btings/ dbus gtsang gi khri skor bcu gsum gyis bzhengs/ de nas dgung lo so drug pa la/ rgyal po chen pos shel gyi dam kha phul/ 'bul ba lan re la yang dngul bre chen stong re phul ba lan gnyis dang / gos dar lnga stong dgu brgya bzhi bcu phul ba la sogs pa'i grangs kyis mi lang ba phul/ zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos kyi 'khor lo bsam gyis mi khyab pas rgyal po yab sras la sogs pa'i gdul bya tshad med pas tshim par byas nas thams cad kyis zhal lta zhing gsung bsgrubs/ thams cad bde ba/ skyid pa/ khrims gnyis la 'jags pa'i ngang nas rgya'i mi yur ma chod snga gong ngo log chen po byung ba/ chos skyongs la 'phrin las bcol bas/ ri med pa'i thang chen po la kha'u skyed lhas kyi brag ri'i char chen chen po phab pas/ ngo log gi dmag thams cad phyir log pa la sogs pa'i rnam 'phrul gyis phyis ngo log thams cad rgyun chad/ gzhan yang rnam par dkar ba'i rnam 'phrul du mas gdul bya dpag tu med pa'i don mdzad nas/ dgung lo zhe gcig pa me pho byi ba'i lo la gdan sa chen por phebs/ bod na yod par grags pa'i mdo rgyud/ man ngag skor/ phra zhing phra ba dang bcas pa nga la yod pas/ khyod rang so so ga la mos pa'i chos nga la zhus shig ces pa'i bka' gnang nas/ shin tu zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos kyi sgo grangs las 'das pa dpes khyud med pa gnang zhing / zang zing gi sbyin pa rgya chen po mdzad de/ me mo glang dpyid zla ra ba la rgyal bu jin kim gyis chu mig ring mor chos 'khor bskor ba'i sbyin bdag mdzad pa'i tshe/

bdag nyid chen po 'dis kyang dge 'dun khri phrag bdun lhag pa la/ zhal zas gya nom pa'i bsnyen bkur/ 'bul ba brgya 'gyed/ dge 'dun so so'i phyag tu gser zho re dang / sum snam re'i 'gyed bzang po mdzad/ gzhan yang nyin re bzhin yang 'byor pa'i khyad par tshad med pa phyag tu babs pa de dag thams cad rang don du til 'bru tsam yang mi 'dzin par/ gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa dang / der bzhugs pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten bzhengs pa/ de dag gi drung du mchod pa'i rgyun 'dzugs pa/ dge 'dun gyi sde 'dzugs pa/ phongs pa rnams la sbyin pa gtong ba la sogs pa bgrang ba las 'das par mdzad do/ /gzhan yang tshul khrims kyi bslab pa'i sgo nas kyang 'gro ba'i don mang du mdzad do/ /snga phyir rang nyid kyis mkhan po mdzad pa dge slong pho mo dang / dge tshul pho mo stong bzhi brgya nyi shu rtsa bzhi dang / nyid kyi slob ma 'dul 'dzin chos kyi mgon po zhes bya bas sman rtser lo gcig gi khongs su/ rgya'i dge slong dang dge tshul brgya dang bzhi bcu'i mkhan po mdzad de/ de rnams las brgyud pa'i rab byung mang pos phyogs thams cad khyab par gyur to/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi bslab pa'ang / phyi rol du mkhas pa'i bya ba rgyun mi 'chad par mdzad kyang / nang du ting nge 'dzin la g.yel ba cung zad kyang mi mnga' bas/ yi dam gyi lha'i zhal gzigs pa dang / 'od gsal rgyun mi 'chad pa dang / mngon par shes pa'i yon tan dpag tu med pa mnga' ste/ skyid grong du jo bo'i drung du byon pa'i tshe/ rje btsun spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug zhal gzigs pa la mnal lam du bstod pa mdzad pa dang / ri bo rtse lngar byon pa'i tshe/ /rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi zhal gzigs nas bstod pa mdzad pa dang / yang chos rje sa paṇa byang ngos la 'byon pa'i dus su/ yang dgon pas mjal te/ bla ma ni gong la gshegs par gda'/ bdag cag dpon slob rnams la phyag dang bsnyen bkur byed pa dang /

mos gus kyi gnas su gyur pa'i sku tshab gcig 'tshal bar gda' ba la/ dbon po 'di pa yang dag pa lags sam zhus pas/ dbon po rnal ma lags gsung nas/ bla ma 'di pha tshad na rdo gcig 'dug pa la brnyes/ spyan ma btsum par mnal du song 'dug pa bstan nas 'di 'od gsal zin pa'i rtags lags/ spyir nged kyi mi brgyud rnal ma la 'od gsal cung zad re rgyun mi chad du yod pa yin gsungs/ rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta go tam shri bha dra la/ mtshan mo rmi lam ji ltar byung ba thams cad/ bdag nyid chen po 'dis mngon par shes pas mkhyen nas/ nang par paṇ+ḍi ta la gsung byon pa'i tshe/ mahā gu ru la mngon par shes pa a tsi zer zhing dad par gyur te/ bla ma 'di gong nas phebs/ 'u yug na bzhugs dus/ phyogs su khral bsdud byung pa la/ /shangs lha phu ba'i jo gdan gcig gis zhu ba la phyin dus/ sgar gyi mthar sems can la 'tshe ba byed la/ hor sog mang pos mtha' bskor/ bla ma 'di sa 'ja' li gcig la bzhugs/ g.yas na rtsom pa mdzad pa'i yig mkhan/ g.yon na bka' shog 'dri ba'i yig mkhan/ mdun na rgyun gtor bshom pa'i gtor skad gton nas chab gtong ba rnams mthong bas/ jo gdan gyi bsam pa la/ bla ma ci'i bla ma/ sems can la 'tshe ba/ mtha' hor sog gis bskor ba/ g.yon gyi bka' shog ni nga zhu ba la 'ongs pa dang 'dra/ gzhan mnar ba yin/ g.yas kyi brtsom pas ci byed/ chos sems thog tu mi 'jogs/ tshig gcig mi bsngo ba'i gtor skad kyis ci byed/ bla mar mi 'dug snyam pa cig byung pa dang / bdag nyid chen po 'dis/ jo gdan la spyan cer te gzigs nas/ gtor ma 'di la bshams pas thob pa kho bos bsham pa yin/ dmigs pas thob pa de ngas byed/ /bsngos pas thob pa de khyod kyis gyis gsung pa dang / jo gdan shin tu skrag nas/ mngon par shes pa thogs pa med pa mnga' bar 'dug pa la/ ngas log lta byas pa ma legs snyam nas/ lus thams cad sa la phab pa'i phyag byas/

bshags pa phul/ mchog tu ngo mtshar bar gyur te bstod tshig gi sgra dbyangs kun du sgrog par gyur/ bla ma'i mdzad spyod thams cad gang la gang 'dul du rtogs/ sems can gsod spyod/ khral 'u lag sogs rang gi las su go nas nges pa'i shes pa khyad par can skyes par gyur te/ lhag pa'i shes rab kyi bslab pa yang dngos dang brgyud pa'i gdul bya'i don du brjod bde zhing rtogs sla ba'i bstan bcos/ bstod pa gsol 'debs/ theg pa che chung / mdo rgyud man ngag 'phral bya ba'i rim pa ston pa/ gsung rab kyi dkar chag gsan yig 'phrin yig bsngo ba dang bkra shis kyi bskor ba la sogs pa ngo mtshar ba du ma zhig mdzad la/ ding sang gi bar du shin tu dar bar mdzad pa yin no/ /bla ma 'di nyid kyi gdan sa che ba ni/ dpal ldan sa skya/ rgyal po'i pho brang chen po ta'i tu'i nang gi sde chen po me tog ra ba dang / pho brang shang rdo dang / byang ngos sprul pa'i sde dang / gdan sa bar sa ni chu mig dpal gyi sde chen dang / mdo khams gtsang mdo bsam 'grub/ shing kun dpal gyi sde chen po'o/ /gdan sa chung ba ni/ bla ma gong ma rnams kyi bzhugs gnas khyad par can rnams bdag tu bzung / thog re bzhugs chos gsungs/ so sor gang 'tshams kyis dge bshes bkos pa'i sa rnams yin la/ yang dben ni rgya nag ri bo rtse lnga/ lha rtse'i brag kha'u skyed lhas kyi brag phug rnams so/ /bla ma 'di nyid kyi slob ma'i mchog ni/ bshad pa'i srol 'dzin shar nub gung gsum la sogs pa'i chen po rnams dang / bla ma chen po grags pa 'od zer khu dbon dang / dga' ldan pa bkra shis dpal la sogs pa mang du byung ngo / /sgrub pa'i srol 'dzin bla ma zhang dkon mchog dpal dang / dge slong kun blo yin no/ /de lta bu'i skyes chen dam pa 'dis grub pa'i mtshan ma ngo mtshar can bstan pa'i rnam thar sngon chad bod 'dir ma grags pa/ dus phyis rgya nag gi gan mdzod kyi yig tshang nas byung ba ngo mtshar 'ja' sa drug pa zhes yongs su grags pa 'di nyid yi ge tshogs skyung ba'i phyir 'dir tshigs su bcad de brjod pa ni 'di ltar/

/'jam pa'i rdo rje'i rnam 'phrul sa skya pa/ /lnga rig rgyud mang dbyangs kyi srid las rgyal/ /pha rol rgol ba tshar gcod dpa' bo che/ /kun dga' rgyal mtshan snying gi pad+mar byon/ /de sras 'phags pa'i thugs mnga' 'gro ba'i mgon/ /bcu bdun mthar son mdo rgyud man ngag gi /lung rtogs yon tan kun rdzogs rgyal ba yi/ /bstan pa'i bdag por mnga' gsol mchod pas mchod/ /gnam gyis bkos te sa la dbang bsgyur ba'i/ /stobs ldan hor gyi rgyal rab bco lnga yi/ /gtsug rgyan se chen go pe lar grags pas/ /khyod zhabs spyi bo'i rgyan du gus pas bsten/ /shar ba'i ngo mtshar 'ja' sa rnam pa drug /ji ltar bstan tshul mdo tsam 'di ltar te/ /'jam dbyangs gzhon nu 'phags pa'i mtshan ldan des/ /rin chen rdul brtsegs dgos mdzad dkyil 'khor du/ /se chen rgyal yum blon por bcas pa la/ /smin byed dbang gi 'khor lo bskor ba'i tshe/ /de slob dpag shir grags pa'i mthu bo ches/ /yid 'ongs rdzu 'phrul rol rtsed sgyur ba'i mod/ /'gran pa bzhin du rgyal yum btsun mo yis/ /'phags pa nyid la thal sbyar pus btsugs te/ /de bas lhag pa'i rdzu 'phrul ston zhes gsol/ /'phags pa nyid kyi zhal pad 'dzum dang bcas/ /'jig rten grags pa'i mtshon gyis yan lag lnga/ /so sor khrol la rigs lngar gsol ba thobs/ /lus gzhan ril po mal du ltos zhes gsungs/ /de yi bka' bzhin yan lag lnga po ni/ /rigs lngar mthong bas rab tu ngo mtshar skyes/ /gzim mal khri steng dbu zhabs ma tshangs ba'i/ /sku lus gshin rje'i khrag gis byung pa bzhin/ /rgyal yum blon 'bangs kun gyis mngon sum mthong / /dad pa'i spu longs 'khri shing g.yo ba dang / /spyan mig chu yi char rgyun 'bab pa bzhin/ /lhan cig dga' dang skyo ba'i snang ba shar/ /se chen rgyal dang btsun mo tsha'u sogs/ /ma bzod thugs ni zar zir gyur na yang / /snying nas gsol ba'i gdugs shugs drag po yis/

/lan mang gsol ba ches cher btab pa las/ /yan lag med pa'i sku de rdzus skyes bzhin/ /lta bas mi ngoms mtshan dpe'i skur lang tshe/ /rgyal po 'khor bcas dga' mgu yi rangs nas/ /sa steng 'di na khyod las lhag pa'i skyabs/ /yod med yid gnyis 'khyogs la 'phyang bral zhes/ /mi phyed dad pas mi zad 'dod dgu yis/ /mchod bstod mnga' gsol 'ja' sa dang po 'o// ༈ //gtsang phyog nor 'dzin pa yi lte ba che/ /chu mig ces grags pad 'dab ltar mdzes par/ /se chen gan gyi 'dod yon mthun rkyen las/ /chu mig chos 'khor chen po skor ba'i tshe/ /ngur smṛg dge 'dun khri tsho bco brgyad dbus/ /bstan 'dzin gdugs thob bcu phrag brgyad cu dang / /rgyal khams skye bo 'bum sdes gang ba'i dbus/ /'phags pa'i blo gros mtshungs bral bla med des/ /skyon bral chos kyi dril chen sgrogs pa'i tshe/ /mkha' la me tog char dang rol mo'i sgra/ /dri zhim spos dang 'ja' ris gur khang sor/ /skye bo kun gyi mngon du gyur pa las/ /byang sems sras brgyad 'khor gyi lha bu sogs/ /dag pa'i snang thob mkhas pa bcu gcig dang / /gser yig gtso bo yon khri 'ching gsang sogs/ /rgyal po'i pho nya bcu gnyis la sogs pa/ /rab dkar bag chags sad pa'i 'gro tshogs kyi/ /de lta'i snang ba mngon du gyur pa'i mod/ /skye 'gro yongs kyi mchod cing bskur ba dang / /khyad par rgyal po'i pho nya yon khri yis/ /'phags pa dges pa'i mchod sprin dpag med dang / /ngur smrig sde dang skye 'gro 'dus pa'i tshogs/ /mi zad 'dod dgu'i mchod sprin dpag med kyis/ /tshim par byas shing bla chen 'phags pa yi/ /che ba'i yon tan bsngags par byas pa 'di/ /ngo mtshar 'ja' sa gnyis pa zhes su grags// ༈ //de nas mkha' la dri zhim thor rlung gis/ /rgya mtsho'i gos can mi gtsang dag byed pa'i/ /gtsang bar byas rjes char dang lhan cig tu/ /sna tshogs me tog bsil ma sa la bkram/

/mkha' la 'ja' gur gsum rim bzhi rims nang / /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas bzhugs pa la/ /rnam bkra gdan gyi 'phreng bzhugs 'phags pa yis/ /chos kyi zhu 'phrin rmad du byung ba'i gtam/ /yongs 'dzin bcu gsum 'chin khri gnyis la sogs/ /log lta'i rnyog bral rna ba'i me long la/ /shar tshe mig la bdud rtsi gsar pa bskrun/ /ngo mtshar de mthong rgyal ba'i pho nya yis/ /mchod stod mnga' gsol 'ja' sa gsum pa 'o// ༈ //nam zhig tshe na 'phags pa'i spyan mnga' ru/ /'ching sangs la sogs skye bo 'dus pa'i tshogs/ /sngar ma myong ba'i gsur gyi dri chen po/ /sna la khyab pas skyugs pa chal chil g.yo/ /'di 'dra ci zhes yon khri sogs kyis zhus/ /dus gsum sgrib med 'phags pa'i zhal mnga' nas/ /mkha' la rigs 'dzin brgyad cu mngon sum byon/ /so bdun yul gyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro yi/ /me tog sogs mchod dur khrod brgyad sogs nas/ /sha chen maṃ sa'i bdug spos 'khyil ba'i dri/ /tha mal skye bos bzod par dka' ba bden/ /de phyir kho bos bdud rtsi 'di 'thung zhes/ /nang gi mchod pa lce la sbyin pa'i mod/ /gzung 'dzin sprin bral dngas pa'i nam mkha' la/ /klu sgrub snying po gtsor bzhugs bi ru g.yas/ /pad+ma badz+ra g.yon te mtha' skor du/ /rgya gar 'phags pa'i grub chen brgya bcu yis/ /dbugs dbyung lung bstan zab rgyas 'doms pa mthong / /ngo mtshar de las rgyas po'i 'phar ma yis/ /mchod cing bsnyen bkur bkra shis me tog gtor/ /de la ngo mtshar 'ja' sa bzhi par grags// ༈ //khengs pa'i nga rgyal thon po'i khri steng na/ /yon tan rmad byung sprin phag nyi ma bzhin/ /gur khang bcom ldan rig pa'i ral dri des/ /'phags mchog de la 'dud par ma gyur tshe/ /'on kyang 'di ni bden nam brdzun bzhes pa'i/ /yid gnyis 'khyogs la 'phyang ba brtag pa'i phyir/ /chu mig chos 'khor nyi ma mtha' ma'i nyin/ /slong mo'i zol gyis lam du bzhugs pa'i tshe/

/gnas brtan mgo dkar gnyer ma'i gong bu can/ /srul po'i gos gyon 'khar ba la 'chel ba/ /bcu drug sa phug nang nas thon pa gzigs/ /'di dag 'phags pa 'di yi 'du 'dzi'i gtam/ /thos nas thag ring yul nas bza' btung la/ /ched du gnyer snyam snying rje'i yul du byas/ /de nas 'phags chen chos kyi rgyal po des/ /chu mig chos kyi khri la zhabs bkod nas/ /yon sbyong bsngo ba smon lam bkra shis kyi/ /tshangs pa'i gsungs dbyangs thos pas yid drangs te/ /ba spu'i 'khri shing cung zad g.yo ba tsam/ /de nas 'phags pa'i bzhugs gnas dra mig nas/ /ngo mtshar bkod pa ci mnyam gzigs pa'i mod/ /za 'og 'bol chen lnga brtsegs bcu drug khrir/ /'phags pa'i gnas brtan bcu drug bzhugs pa la/ /phyag mchod me tog bdug spos sprin 'phreng gis/ /yid 'ong tshad gdung bsil ba'i ngo mtshar mthong / /de tshe sngar mthong sprang po'i zol can de'ang / /'phags pa'i gnas brtan dngos su yid ches rnyed/ /'phrul med 'phags chen don dang mthun no snyam/ /glang chen ma rung lcags kyus btab pa bzhin/ /mi phyed dad pa'i sa gzhi gdan du btings/ /nyes kun bshags gdams thal sbyar spyi bos gtugs/ /bstod pa'i rnga dbyangs tshangs pa'i 'brug sgra zhes/ /snyan tshig 'phreng ba sdebs legs de lnga phul/ /de ltar 'phags pa'i gnas brtan bcu drug ni/ /mgron du bos nas chos kyi bka' bgros pa'i/ /ngo mtshar de mthong yon khri 'ching bzang gis/ /chen po la 'os 'dod dgu'i mchod sprin gyis/ /mchod cing bstod dbyangs dril rnga sgrogs pa ni/ /ngo mtshar 'ja' sa lnga pa zhes su grags// ༈ //de ltar chu mig chos 'khor ni/ /nyi ma bcu bzhi bskor ba las/ /bcu bzhi pa la snar thang gi /rig ral zhi dul gnas su bkod/ /rgya nag rgyal po gan gyi pho brang nas/ /'phags mchog rjes ma bod la zhal bsgyur tshe/ /yan lag bzhi la dbang bsgyur rgyal po ni/ /bcu gcig 'bum phrag 'khor dang bcas pa yis/

/dbus su brjid pa se chen bying gi de/ /mi 'bral lcags sgrog dam du bcings pa bzhin/ /skyel ma'i tshul du ma phyir bu bzhin 'brangs/ /phyin chad yon mchod mi mjal rten 'brel gyis/ /zhags pas drang bzhin zhag nas zla ba dang / /zla ba lo'i rim pas drangs pa'i dpes/ /bod yul spob ra lha zhol rma chu'i 'gram/ /mchod yon mi 'bral grib bzhin gdan 'dzom tshe/ /mkha' dang sa gzhi dge mtshan 'gran pa bzhin/ /bkra shis 'dzum pa'i dge mtshan ci yang ston/ /mkha' dbyings shar nub sprin dkar glang chen sna/ /brkyang pa'i rtse la rnal 'byor dbang phyug dang / /sa skya'i bla chen zhal 'dzum ngoms pa la/ /rgya bod rgyud pas bskor ba mngon sum byon/ /spom ra lha yi mgul par rab mdzes 'brug /'khyud pa'i lce dbang gdan du bting pa'i khrir/ /bla ma 'phags pa'i zhabs sen bkod pa yis/ /ngo mtshar rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs bstan pa'i dpal/ /mtha' yi rgyal sras bcu gcig se chen gan/ /'khor 'bangs snang ba dag pa kun gyis mthong / /rgyal dbang 'khor bcas dga' bas thugs tshims nas/ /mchod cing gsol btab tshe rabs thams cad du/ /'phags pa rab dges 'khor gyi thog ma ru/ /skye ba'i smon lam btab tshe bkra shis pa'i/ /dge legs mtshan ma mthong zhes ya mtshan gtam/ /de ni 'gro mgon 'phags pa yi/ /ngo mtshar 'ja' sa drug pa ste/ /rgya nag gan gyi yig tshang las/ /gsal bar thos pa'i ngo mtshar gtam/ /sngon med blo gsal dang 'dod kyi/ /dad pa spel byed de tsam mo/ /zhes ngo mtshar 'ja' sa drug pa'i don rnams nyung ngu'i ngag gis brjod de/ da ni skyes chen dam pa de nyid zhing 'dis bstan pa dang sems can gyi don mthar phyin nas/ gdul bya gzhan gyi don la dgongs pa'i tshul ni/ de ltar sku phra mo'i dus na mnal lam du spa lcag tshigs brgyad cu byas pa gcig phyag tu byung ba'i tshigs bzhi bcu zhe drug zhe bdun gyi tshigs skyog por song 'dug pa/

sang chos rje pa la zhus pas/ khyod kyi tshe'i mtshon byed yin gsung ba ltar/ ngo mtshar ba'i mdzad pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas zhing 'di'i gdul bya'i don mdzad pas/ rangs par gyur nas/ zhing gzhan du gshegs par bzhed de/ lcags pho 'brug go lo zla ba bcu pa'i tshes gcig nas chos rje'i dus mchod tshugs/ sngar bas thugs dam dang mchod pa sogs lhag par mdzad pa la/ drung na 'khod pa rnams kyis chos rje'i dus mtshan zla ba bcu gcig pa min lags bsam zhus pas/ de bzhin yin mod kyi/ bla ma chos kyi rje la gsol ba 'debs pa ni zla ba re tsam byed pa dam bcas pa yin pas/ bcu gcig pa'i zla ba tshang mar maṇ+ḍal 'bul rgyu sogs ma byung gis dogs nas bsu ba yin mod gsung / dus mchod btsugs pa'i zhag gsum pa tshes gsum gyi nub mo dpal gyi ri la 'phags pa klu sgrub byang chub kyi shing rgyas pa'i drung na bzhugs pa la/ dbu ma rigs tshogs la sogs pa theg pa chen po'i chos du ma gsan pa la lha'i tshogs kyi mchod pa rgya chen po byed pa dang / rig pa'i rgyal mo rma bya chen mo gsal bar gzigs pa'i snang ba byung / de'i rnam par thar pa ni ma 'ongs pa'i sems can la phan par dgongs nas bdag nyid chen po 'di nyid kyi zhal lta mdzad de/ khang gsar gyi gzim khang gi brgyang logs la bris nas bzhugs so/ /de'i rjes su bdag nyid chen po dharma pha la la sa skya pa chen po la sogs pa bla ma gong ma rnams kyis rnam par thar pa gsungs shing / bla ma nyid kyis bstan pa'i bya ba mdzad tshul yang gsungs te/ khyod kyis kyang de bzhin du go dgos gsungs nas/ tshes bco brgyad kyi bar du tshogs su byon chos kyang gsungs/ de nas zhag bzhi gzim khang du bzhugs nas/ nyer gnyis kyi snga dro nyi ma me bzhi 'phrod pa'i tshe/ dkon mchog la mchod pa rgya cher shoms shig gsungs nas skyil krung mdzad/ rdo rje dang dril bu bsnams/ thugs dam la rtse gcig tu bzhugs nas lha khang bla brang du bde bar gshegs so/

/de'i tshe sngar tshor ma myong ba'i dri khyad par can dang / me tog gi char 'bab pa la sogs pa ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dpag tu med pa byung zhing / khyad par bshangs pa slob dpon gzhon nu zhes pa/ 'jam dbyangs sngon por grags pas gdung khang zhal yang ma phye ba la/ drung du phyin yus pas mgo zhal ba la mang du brdab gsol ba btab pas/ gdung khang gi seng phug gcig nas sol rdog nag ril tsam gcig 'phir byung ba gdan drangs/ brang khang du sleb pa dang sol rdog brad pas/ gdung rus gcig byon pa phyag gi mthe bong gi tshigs yin pa la/ khab phra mo tsam gyi rigs lnga bzhengs sku lha'i rnam pa can byon pa la gsol ba btab pas/ zhal phyag brgyad la sogs pa shin tu gsal bar byon shin tu dad nas chos 'khor gyi dus su/ tsam nas khal lnga brgya phul/ sku byon pa gsang nas shangs brud kyi dgon pa rin chen mdzod du gdan drangs/ phyis su slob dpon pa'i sku nye rnams zhabs tog su byed la ma 'cham/ slob dpon grags gzhon pa'i nang rten thub pa khru tshad gcig bzhengs pa'i nang du bzhugs su gsol nas/ brud kyi rin chen mdzod kyi mchod khang gi rten gral gyi gtso bo la bzhugs pa dus phyis rje kun dga' grol mchog gi phyag nas brgyud de smon grol pa'i lag tu byung pa sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la dad pa'i dbang gis rtsol med du byung ba de nyid da lta gdan sa chen po'i mchod khang na bzhugs so/ /de dag gi ni bstan bcos rtsom pa po'i sku che ba'i yon tan mdo tsam bstan pa bshad zin nas/ gnyis pa des mdzad pa'i bstan bcos dngos kyi don bshad pa ni 'di ltar/ 'dzam gling rgyal po'i bla ma mdo sde dang rgyud sde mtha' dag gi mnga' bdag sgra dang / tshad ma dang / snyan ngag dang / sdebs sbyor la sogs pa shes bya'i gnas thams cad la mi 'jigs pa'i spobs pa brnyes pa kha ba can gyi ljongs 'di'i thub pa'i rgyal tshab chen po dpal ldan 'phags pa'i zhabs nyid kyis skye dgu dang bcas pa'i sa'i dbang phyug du ma'i rigs su 'khrungs pa/

mngon par mtho ba'i dpal 'byor rnams thos kyi bu dang mtshungs pa/ 'jig rten dang chos kyi tshul mkhyen pa'i spobs pa dge bar gnas pas mi mthun phyogs dag zil gyis gnon pa/ mi phyed pa'i dad pas bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa dang de 'dzin pa'i skyes bu dam pa dag rang gi srog bzhin du gces par 'dzin pa/ rgyal bu 'ji big de mur gyis zhus shing gsol ba btab pa'i ngor nor bu'i 'phreng ba 'di mdzad pa yin no/ /de 'chad pa na/ bshad pa la 'jug pa dang / bshad pa dgod pa dang / bshad pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i bya ba gsum gyis nges par bya'o/ /dang po la yang mchod par brjod pa dang / shis pa brjod pa dang / spri yig gi khyad par dang / de'i dgos pa bstan pa bzhi'o/ /de la dang po ni/ bsod nams rgya mtshor rab tu 'khrungs/ ye shes tshogs kyi che ba'i sku/ /dpag yas yon tan gyis brgyan pa'i/ /rgyal ba lhun po la phyag 'tshal/ /zhes bya ba yin no/ /'dis ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das ri'i rgyal po ri rab dang mtshungs par bstan ste/ 'di ltar ri'i rgyal po ri rab rnams ni rgya mtsho'i dbus su 'khrungs pa dang / lhun stug cing 'phang mtho bas che ba dang / lha ma yin dang lha'i dpal 'byor du mas brgyan pa yin no/ /de bzhin du sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyang sbyin pa la sogs pa'i bsod nams rgya mtsho'i dbus su 'khrungs pa'i gzugs kyi brnyes pa dang / ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi tshogs kyis che ba'i chos kyi sku brnyes pa dang / stobs dang mi 'jigs pa la sogs pa nges par legs pa'i yon tan du mas brgyan pa yin te/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi gzugs sku 'dir/ /bsod nams tshogs las 'khrungs pa ste/ /chos kyi sku de mdor bsdu na/ /rgyal po ye shes tshogs las 'khrungs/ /zhes bya ba dang / nyes pa kun las rnam grol zhing / /yon tan kun gyis brgyan pa po/

/sems can kun gyi gnyen cig po/ /thams cad mkhyen la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin no/ /de lta bu'i bstod pa 'di yang 'phags pa dkon mchog brtsegs pa las ji ltar rgya mtsho'i dbus na ni/ /lhun po'i rgyal po brjid pa ltar/ /de bzhin dge 'dun dbus na yang / /chos kyi rgyal po rnam par mdzes/ /zhes rgyal po rnam par mdzes zhes rgyal po dge ba'i bkod pas sangs rgyas la bstod pa dang / 'phags pa dkon mchog sprin las rab tu mi bsgul ri bo dang / gting mtha' yangs pa rgya mtsho 'dra/ mu stegs gzhan gyis mi g.yo ba'i/ /chos rgyal khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes gsungs pa dang mthun par mdzad pa yin no/ /des na 'di skad bstan pa yin te/ bsod nams kyi tshogs las 'khrungs pa'i gzugs kyi sku dang / ye shes kyi tshogs las 'khrungs pa'i chos kyi sku dang / de dag mdzes par byed pa'i stobs la sogs pa yon tan du mas brgyan pa'i rgyal ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes bya ba ste rgyal ba ni bdud bzhi las rgyal ba'o/ /gnyis pa bkra shis par brjod pa ni/ dge ba rgya mtsho'i gling du 'khrungs/ rigs gzugs 'byor pa'i gzi brjid ldan/ /rang srid rnam par skyong ba'i dpal/ /rgyal bu rin chen rgyal gyur cig /ces bya ba gsungs te/ 'di ni rgyal po nyid nor bu rin po che dang 'dra bar bstan te/ 'di ltar nor bu rnams ni rgya mtsho'i gling du 'khrungs pa dang / kha dog dang dbyibs kyi gzi brjid 'bar ba dang / gsol ba btab na 'dod pa'i don thams cad sgrub pa'o/ /de bzhin du rgyal bu khyod kyang skye ba snga ma'i dge ba rgya mtsho'i gling du 'khrungs pa dang rgyal po'i rigs phun sum tshogs pa dang / gzugs bzang pa dang longs spyod dang 'byor pa phun sum tshogs pa'i gzi brjid 'bar ba dang / rang gi srid sde dang 'bangs thams cad chos kyi khrims kyis rnam par skyong ba'i dpal du gyur pas de dag gi 'dod pa'i don thams cad sgrub pa'o/

rgyal gyur cig ces bya ba ni tshe 'di'i bde ba la bar du gcod pa nad dang gdon la sogs pa dang / mtho ris la bar du gcod pa mi dge ba dang / thar pa la bar du gcod pa sgrib pa rnams las rgyal nas tshe 'di la tshe dang longs spyod dbang phyug 'phel ba dang / phyi ma la mtho ris du ma brgyud nas de nas thar pa phun sum tshogs par gyur cig ces smon pa dang ldan par brjod pa'o/ /gsum pa spring yig gi khyad par brjod pa ni/ tshul khrims dag pa'i gzhi brtan zhing / /mang du thos pa'i chu gter can/ /yon tan rin chen tshogs 'dzin pa/ /'phags pa'i blo yi rgya mtsho las/ /zhes bya bas mdzad pa po'i khyad par bstan te/ 'dis ni bdag cag gi bla ma nyid rgya mtsho chen po dang 'dra bar bstan te/ rgya mtsho rnams ni gzhi brtan pa'i steng na gnas pa dang / bdag nyid chu du ma 'tshogs pa'i gter yin pa dang / mar gad dang pad+ma ra ga dang / rdo rje'i snying po la sogs pa nor bu rin po che du mas tshogs 'dzin pa yin no/ /de bzhin du rnam par 'dren pa chen po 'di yang so so thar pa'i sdom pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i sems bskyed dang / /gsang sngags kyi dam tshig rnam par dag pa'i tshul khrims kyi gzhi brtan par gnas pa dang / mdo sde dang / rgyud sde dang / phyi nang gi bstan bcos rnams mang du gsan pa'i mkhyen rabs kyi chu gter du ma tshogs pa dang / 'chad pa dang / brtsod pa dang / brtsam pa la sogs pa gsung rnam par dag pa'i yon tan dang / gzhi gnas kyis dmigs pa la 'dzin pa dang / lhag mthong gis de bzhin nyid rtogs pa dang / zung du 'brel pas mnyam par gnas pa dang / rjes las thob pas shes bya rnam par 'byed pa la sogs pa thugs rnam par dag pa'i yon tan dang / zhi ba'i las la sogs pa cho ga'i bya ba dang / bzo dang gso ba la sogs pa sku rnam par dag pa'i yon tan rin po che'i tshogs 'dzin pas rgya mtsho dang 'dra bas 'phags pa'i blo yi rgya mtsho ste/

'phags pa ni sdig pa mi dge ba las ring du song ba'i phyir ro/ /blo ni mkhyen rab ste sngar smos pa'i khyad par gsum dang ldan pa'o/ /de lta bu'i rgya mtsho las byung ba'i spring yig nor bu'i 'phreng / phyogs kun gsal ba'i 'od 'byin zhing / /bdag gzhan mdzes pa skyed pa'i rgyan/ /bsam pa dge bas ring nas 'bul/ /zhes bya ba ni spring yig gi khyad par ste/ 'dis ni spring yig 'di nor bu'i 'phreng ba dang 'dra bar bstan te/ 'di ltar nor bu'i 'phreng ba rnams ni rgya mtsho las byung pa dang / gang du bzhag pa'i phyogs de'i mun pa gsal nas snang par byed pa dang / rgyan du byas pas bdag dang gzhan gyi lus mdzes par byed pa dang / ya mtshan du gyur pa'i nor yin pas chen po rnams la 'bul bar 'os pa'o/ /de bzhin du spring yig 'di yang gong du smos pa'i blo gros rnam par dag pa'i rgya mtsho las byung pa dang / gang gi blo la gnas pa de'i ma rig pa'i mun pa bsal nas 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i tshul rtogs pa'i blo'i 'od zer 'byin pa dang / tshul bzhin du thos pas bdag gi blo gros mdzes par byed pa dang / de bzhin du brjod pas gzhan gyi blo gros mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan 'di ni 'jig rten pa rnams dang thun mongs ma yin pa'i ngo mtshar du gyur pa'i nor yin pas bsam pa dge bas ring nas 'bul zhes bya ste/ bsam pa dge ba ni phan par bzhed pa'o/ /ring nas 'bul ba ni thag ring po nas ste yul gyis bskal yang don chen po dang ldan pa'i phyir shin tu brtson pas 'bul zhes bya'o/ /don de dag slob ma la springs pa las/ bstan pa rin chen mchog ltar bzang la phan med pa/ /rnam par dag tshul gang yin klu mgo'i gdengs ka can/ /chen po rnams kyi gtsug gi rgyan bzhin gus mnos nas/ /sa yi gting na gnas pa'i rab rib sel bar mdzad/ /ces gsungs pa bzhin no/ /bzhi pa spring yig gi dgos pa bstan pa ni/

khyed kyi dpal 'byor phun tshogs phyir/ /nor gyi skyes gyi ci zhig bgyi/ /dgung zla'i 'od kyis kun+da ltar/ /gsal bar bgyi slad chos skyes 'bul/ /zhes bya ba yin te/ gal te sa'i dbang phyug la 'di lta bu'i rtog pa ming mnga' yang zur na gnas pa kha cig chen po rnams ni nor gyi skyes kyis bskur bar 'os so snyam na rgyal bu khyod kyi dpal 'byor ni lha'i dbang po brgya byin ltar phun sum tshogs pa'i phyir nor gyi skyes bskur bas don med de/ blon po'i mchog gsos pa zhes bya bas/ ko'u sham+bhi yi rgyal po rab snang la/ /nyin par mar me bus pa don med do/ /rgya mtshor char ba babs pa don med do/ /'grangs la ston mo byin pa don med do/ /skyes bu ngan pa bsten pa don med do/ /zhes gsungs pa lta bu'o/ /'on kyang nam mkha' la zla ba'i 'od zer shar bas kun+da'i tshal thams cad rnam par 'byed pa ltar/ rgyal bu khyod kyi blo'i kun da gsal bar bgyi ba'i slad du bde bar gshegs pas legs par gsungs pa'i chos kyi skyes 'di 'bul lo zhes bya ste/ blo'i kun+da gsal ba ni 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos kyi tshul ji lta ba bzhin rtogs pa ste de ni bstan bcos 'di yi dgos pa yin no/ /de skad du yang 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mkhar gyi rgyal po bde spyod la/ thub pa chen po'i bka' ni snyan dgu zhig /khyod kyi thugs su lta yang chud mod kyi/ /rdo thal las bgyis dgung zla'i 'od kyis ni/ /ches dkar nyid du'ang ci ste mi bgyid lags/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin no/ /da ni bshad pa dgod pa 'chad pa na/ /'jig rten dang chos kyi dpal 'byor zung du 'brel ba'i phan yon dang / 'jig rten pa'i lugs bstan pa dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa'i tshul bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ gang la 'di dpal phun tshogs kyang / /chos dpal rnam par mi ldan na/ /dug bcas kha zas bzang za bzhin/

/sdug bsngal 'ba' zhig skyed pa lags/ /zhes bya ba ni chos dang mi ldan pa'i 'byor pa la spyod pa ni dug dang bcas pa'i kha zas bzang po za ba dang 'dra ba nyid du bstan te/ skye bo gang la tshe 'di'i dpal 'byor gzugs bzang pa dang rigs btsun pa dang longs spyod che ba dang / 'khor g.yog mang pa dang / chos srid rgyas pa la sogs pa phun sum tshogs pa yod kyang 'og nas 'chad pa'i chos kyi dpal dang mi ldan na shi 'phos pa dang ngan song rnams su skyes nas sdug bsngal 'ba' zhig skyed pa lags te/ sngon grong khyer 'phags rgyal zhes bya ba'i rgyal po 'phags skyes po zhes bya ba mtha' bzhi las rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal srid kyi 'byor pa phun sum tshogs pa'i bde ba myong yang chos kyi 'byor pa med pas shākya bdun khri bdun stong la sogs pa bsad de shi 'phos ma thag tu blon po dang bcas pa dmyal ba mnar med par song ste/ las kyis sgrubs pa'i me'i nang du bskal pa'i bar du bsregs so zhes gsungs pa bzhin no/ /dpe ni dug dang bcas pa'i kha zas za ba bzhin te/ dug dang bcas pa'i kha zas bzang po za ba na dri dang ro phun sum tshogs pas bde yang zhu ba na na ba dang / tsha ba dang / zug zer dang bcas te 'chi ba'i sdug bsngal myong ba bzhin no/ /chos kyi dpal dang ldan yang 'jig rten gyi 'byor pas dben na gzhan gyi don rgya chen po sgrub par mi nus so zhes bstan pa'i phyir/ gang zhig chos kyi dpal ldan yang / /'jig rten dpal gyis dben gyur na/ /shun par bcas pa'i rin chen ltar/ /gzhan gyi don du 'gyur ma lags/ /zhes gsungs te/ dge sbyong gang zhig lung dang mngon par rtogs pa'i chos kyi dpal dang ldan yang gzugs bzang ba dang / longs spyod che ba la sogs pa 'jig rten pa'i dpal 'byor gyis dben na shun pa dang / dri ma dang / ljan ljin dang bcas pa'i rin po che dag tshong pa nyams chung pa rnam kyi 'dor ba ltar 'gro rnams gus pa yid ches pa dang /

bka' gnyan par mi 'gyur bas na gzhan gyi don du mi 'gyur te/ sngon mkhas pa ba glang bdag ces bya ba khams gsum las rnam par grol zhing gser dang bong ba mnyam pa'i dgra bcom pa yang gzugs ngan pas gzhan gyis smod pa dang ma dad pas sdig pa'i rkyen du 'gyur bar rig te sum cu rtsa gsum gyi shi ri shi ka'i gzhal yas khang du bcom ldan 'das kyis gnang ste gcig pur gnas so zhes gsungs pa bzhin dang / bram ze bde byed dga' bas kyang / /nya pa'i tshogs kyis rin chen rin thang med rnyed nas/ /kun gyis rab bsnams yang yang myangs shing brdar mod kyi/ /dri dang ro dang kha dog 'dod bzhin ma rnyed nas/ /rnam par smad de rgya mtsho'i nang du dor ces grags/ /kwa yi rin chen blun po'i tshogs kyi lag 'grams na/ /ma bsregs ma brdungs phye mar brlag par ma byas par/ /rang gi gnas su phyin pa dga' ba cis mi bsgom/ /bde byed dga' ba'ang gnas skabs de dang 'dra bar gyur/ /ces pa dang / yon tan bdun brjod pa las kyang / sngar bshad yon tan phun sum tshogs/ /skal ba ngan pas mdangs phrogs pas/ /sdang pa'i gnas su gyur pa'i phyir/ /drang srong bran dang mtshungs pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /da ni gang la chos dang 'jig rten gyi 'byor pa gnyis ka yod na rang gzhan gyi don thams cad grub po zhes bstan pa'i phyir/ gang la de gnyis phun tshogs na/ /gnyis ka'i don chen 'grub 'gyur te/ /thabs kyis zin pa'i rin po che/ /rang gzhan mdzes par bgyid pa ltar/ /de slad nyid la tshul gnyis kyi/ /dpal dang ldan pa gang lags pa/ /kun nas 'bras bu mchis bgyi'i slad/ /'di brjod pa la brtse gcig dgongs/ zhes gsungs te/ skye bo gang la 'jig rten gyi 'byor pa'i thabs kyis zin pa'i chos kyi dpal 'byor yod na rang dang gzhan gyi don grub par 'gyur te/ dper na shun pa sbyangs pa dang legs par bkru ba dang byi dor bya ba dang /

rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo la 'dogs pa dang mchod pa dang gsol ba 'debs pa la sogs pa'i thabs kyis zin pa'i rin po che rang nyid kyang mdzes par byed pa dang / skyes bu gzhan mdzes pa'i rgyan du gyur pa dang / de dag gi 'dod pa'i don sgrub pa bzhin no/ /de yang sngon rgyal po byams pa'i stobs zhes bya ba chos kyi dpal 'byor gyi skye dgu dang bcas pa'i sa chen po rnam par bskyangs te/ sems can thams cad la 'tshe ba med pa'i mchod sbyin dag mdzad nas rang gi lugs kyi khrag gis kyang gnod sbyin dag tshim par byas nas mthar rang nyid shākya'i rgyal por sangs rgyas nas sems can de dag kyang thar pa la bkod pa bzhin no/ /rgyu mtshan de'i slad du rgyal bu nyid la 'jig rten dang chos kyi tshul gnyis kyis dpal 'byor dang ldan pa gang lags pas 'di dang phyi ma mngon par mthong ba dang / nges par legs pa'i 'bras bu dang bcas par bgyi ba'i slad du/ nor bu'i 'phreng ba'i bstan bcos brjod pa la thugs rtse gcig tu dgongs mdzod/ ces mnyan par 'os pa nyid du bstan pa yin te/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis rgyal po bde spyod la/ las rnams mngon du chos btang zhing / /bar du chos ldan tha mar yang / /chos ldan sgrub pa'i sa bdag ni/ /'di dang gzhan du gnod mi 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba dang / phan pa smra ba dkon pa ste/ /nyan par byed pa shin tu dkon/ /de dag pas kyang mi nyan yang / /phan pa'i rjes su byed pa dkon/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin no/ /da ni 'jig rten pa'i chos lugs bstan pa la so sor bshad pa dang / don bsdu ba gnyis kyi shes bya'o/ /dang po la dgu ste 'byor pas dregs pa yang pa dang / rgud pas zhum pa spang pa dang / phan pa byas la drin du gzo ba dang / mchod par 'os pa rnams bkur bar bya ba dang / dman pa rnams bskyangs par bya ba dang / phyogs gzhan rnams dbang du bya ba dang / yul 'khor chos bzhin du bskyangs pa dang /

longs spyod bag yod par bya ba dang / bya ba rnams legs par brtags te bya ba'o/ /dang po ni/ nyi ma'i 'od dang rgya mtsho'i gling / /lhun po'i brtan pa gang lags pa'ang / /dus mthar nyams par 'gyur lags na/ /'gro ba'i 'byor pa smos ci 'tshal/ /'di 'dra mkhyen pas khyad dpal gyis/ /khyod thugs dregs par ma 'gyur zhing / /dpal gyi dpal yang 'phel bgyi'i slad/ /rtag tu bag yod bsten 'tshal lo/ /zhes bya ste 'di ltar gsal byed kyi mchog nyi ma'i 'od dang / mang du bsags pa'i mchog rgya mtsho'i gling / /sra ba'i mchog ri'i rgyal po'i brtan pa gang lags pa'ang dus kyi mthar babs pa na me dang chu dang rlung dag gis 'jig cing nyams par 'gyur lags na 'gro ba rnams kyi dregs pa'i rgyu rigs bzang pa dang / gzugs mdzes pa dang / 'khor mang pa dang / lang tsho rgyas pa dang / dbang thang che ba la sogs pa'i 'byor pa rnams 'jig pa dang / nyams pa smos kyang ci 'tshal te/ bshes pa'i spring yig las/ sa dang lhun po rgya mtsho nyi ma bdun/ /'bar bas bsregs pa'i lus can 'di dag gi /thal ba yang ni lus par mi 'gyur na/ /shin du nyams chung mi lta smos ci 'tshal/ /zhes bya ba dang / sngon skal pa dang po'i tshe rgyal po gso sbyong 'phags zhes bya ba'i spyi bo nas skyes pa'i rgyal po nga la nu zhes bya ba mtha' bzhi las rnam par rgyal zhing / rgyal srid rin po che bdun dang ldan pa/ gling bzhi la dbang byas te/ sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha'i dbang po brgya byin stan phyed la bzhag kyang 'dod pas ma ngoms bzhin du tshe'i dus byas so zhes gsungs pa lta bu'o/ /don de dag slob dpon chos ldan rab 'byor dbyangs kyis/ gang gi sa 'og 'dzul te klu'i dbang po'ang pad+ma'i rtsa ba ltar 'byin byed/ /mtho ris 'dzegs te dbang por byas pa'i lha tshogs mid par byed pa dang / /sa steng bskor bskor nirarga dang ni ra gu na la btus gyur pa/

/'chi bdag des mi tshugs pa gang du gnas te khyod ni 'jigs med gnas/ zhes bya ba dang / lung las kyang / bsags pa kun gyi mtha' mdzad cing / /'dus pa'i mtha' ni 'bral ba ste/ /mthon po'i mtha' ni lhung pa yin/ /gson pa yis ni 'chi ba yin/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin no/ /des na 'byor pa thams cad mi rtag pa 'di 'dra bar mkhyen par bgyis na rgyal bu khyod kyang rang gi rigs bzang ba la sogs pa 'byor pa rnams kyis khyod kyi thugs dregs pa dang / nga rgyal bar mi 'gyur ba dang / tshe 'di'i 'byor pa'i dpal gyis tshe phyi ma'i dpal 'byor 'phel bar bgyi ba'i slad du sbyin pa gtong ba dang / tshul khrims bsrung ba la sogs pa bag yod pa rtag tu brten 'tshal te/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis/ longs spyod g.yo ba snying po med mkhyen nas/ /dge sbyongs bram ze bkren dang bshes rnams la/ /sbyin pa tshul bzhin stsal bgyi pha rol tu/ /sbyin las gzhan pa'i gnyen mchog ma mchis so/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / sngon skal pa dang po'i tshe grong khyer mi thi li zhes bya bar rgyal po mu khyud ces bya ba mtha' bzhi las rnam par rgyal ba/ rin po che bdun dang ldan pa gling bzhi la dbang bsgyur zhing chos kyi khrims kyis rgyal srid skyongs pa zhig bzhugs pa sum cu rtsa gsum pa rnams kyi spyan drangs te/ brgya byin gyis bstan phyed la bzhag pa na/ rgyal po mu khyud kyis/ ji ltar snod dang shing rta dag /re shig dus kyi gnyan po ltar/ /gzhan dag dbang bsgyur gang yin pa'i/ /gnas kyang de dang 'dra ba yin/ /'di nas mi thi lar song la/ /dge ba mang po rnams bya ste/ /bsod nams bsags shing 'byor byas nas/ /mtho ris su ni 'dzeg par bya/ /zhes gsungs nas mi yi yul du byon te slar yang sems can rnams chos kyi 'byor pas bde bar byas nas sems can rnams kyi 'dren par gyur te zhes gsungs pa bzhin du bslab par bya'o/

/gnyis pa rgud pas zhum pa spangs pa ni/ sdug bsngal ba yis thugs 'byung dang / /bde ba'ang 'gyur ba'i chos can dang / /kun kyang kun 'byung las 'byung dang / /de yis de'i rgyu mdzad bgyid par/ /khyod kyis rtag tu dgongs bgyis nas/ /bdag dang gzhan gyi gdung pas thugs/ /kun nas nyon mongs ma 'gyur zhing / /dge ba'i rkyen du 'gyur bar mdzod/ /ces bya ba ste/ ngan song gsum dang 'dod pa'i mi dang lha 'ga' zhig kyang sreg pa la sogs pa sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal can du yid la bya zhing / de dag la thugs dbyung zhing skyong bar bya ba dang / mtho rigs kyi bde ba rnams kyang 'gyur ba'i chos can yin par 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal du yid la bya ba dang / ngan song ba dang mtho ris pa'i 'jig rten kun kyang las dang nyon mongs pa kun 'byung las byung ba'i mi rtag pa nyid du yid la byas te 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal du bsam pa dang / sdug bsngal de dag myong bar byas pas kyang sdug bsngal de'i rgyu kun 'byung las dang nyon mongs pa de mdzad par bgyid pa yin no zhes rgyal bu khyod kyis rtag tu dgongs par bgyis nas bdag dang bdag gi gnyen gzhan dag sdug bsngal gyis gdungs par gyur kyang de dag gis yid kun nas nyon mongs pa dang zhum pa dang sgyid lug par mi 'gyur zhing / 'khor ba thams cad sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin du rig nas de dag las thar pa la brtson par bya'o/ /zhes dge ba'i rkyen du 'gyur bar mdzod ces bya te/ de ltar yang rin po che'i 'phreng ba las/ lha yi phun sum tshogs pas kyang / /khengs pa nyid du mi bgyi zhing / /yid btags bzhin du dbul ba yis/ /rgud pas kyang ni zhum mi bgyid/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / mdo sde skyes pa'i rab las/ yid chad rgud pa'i ngo lon thabs ma yin/ /de phyir mi dga' 'dzin pa gtang bar bya/ /dgos pa sgrub la mkhas rnams sran thub pas/ /dka' ba rnams kyang dka' ba med par rgal/

/zhes gsungs pa dang / sngon rgyal po kri kri'i bu mo sngon gyi rgyal ba la lhag par bya ba byas shing dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa/ smon lam gyi stobs las byung pa bdun 'khor ba dang 'dod pa'i yon tan rnams la sbrul gdug ltar yid rab tu skyo bar byas te/ rgyal srid kyi bde ba rnams sbrul gyi lpags pa bzhin du dor te nags su gnas nas dge ba la brtson par byas te thar pa thob pa yin no/ /zhes lung dang gzhon nu ma bdun gyi rtogs pa brjod pa las gsungs pa ltar bslab par bya'o/ /gsum pa phan pa byas pa la drin du gzo ba ni/ tshogs dang smon lam mthun pa'i mthus/ /dngos dang brgyud pas nyid kyi sku/ /bskyed bgyis yab yum brgyud bcas kyi/ /bka' drin dgongs par mdzod cig dang / /tshul lugs dge ba spyad pa'i phyir/ /gdung brgyud chu bo lta bu dang / /de dag nyid la 'dun pa dang / /dgongs pa'ang ji bzhin sgrub 'gyur lags/ /zhes bya ba gsungs te/ sngon gyi sbyin pa dang tshul khrims la sogs pa'i tshogs bsags pa dang / bdag cag lhan cig tu pha dang / ma dang / bu dang / bu mo dang / nye du 'brel pa rnams su gyur cig ces smon lam mthun par btab pa'i mthu la brten nas rgyal bu nyid kyi sku dngos su bskyed par byed pa yab dang yum dang / brgyud nas bskyed pa'i rgyu mes po la sogs pa brgyud pa dang bcas pa rnams kyi bka' drin dran pas de dag la gus pa dang / bkur ba dang / dus kyi mchod pa dang / de dag gis ched du dge ba'i bya ba la dgongs par mdzod cig dang / de ltar byas na 'jig rten gyi tshul lugs dge ba legs par spyad pa'i phyir/ de'i bsod nams kyi dpal la brten nas rgyal bu nyid kyi gdung brgyud rnams chu bo'i rgyun ltar rigs pa dang / gang la gus pa dang bkur ba byas pa de dag rnams kyang rgyal bu nyid la gus pa dang bkur ba dang yid rab du 'dun pa dang dgongs pa'i don thams cad sgrub par 'gyur ba lags te/

bad pa'i rgyal po 'chad byed kyi zhus pa'i mdo las/ gang dag pha ma rgas pa gso bar byed pa ni/ /de dag nor dang 'bru ni mi nyung pa dag dang / /chung ma bu dang bu mo dag pa dag dang yang / /bi ru rgya dang rin chen sa le sbram yang rnyed/ /gang dag pha ma rgas pa gso bar byed pa ni/ /de dag rab 'phrul lha yi pho brang dag dang ni/ /rtsub 'gyur dang ni 'dres pa'i tshal yang mthong 'gyur zhing / /lha rnams du mas rtag tu mdun du brdar bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis kyang / pha ma sri zhu lhur len dang / /rigs kyi gtso la rim gro dang / /longs spyod legs spyod bzod gtong dang / /tshig 'jam phra ma med bden pa'i/ /brtul zhugs tshe gcig byas pa des/ /lha yi dbang po nyid thob nas/ /da dung du yang lha dbang bgyid/ /de bas de 'dra'i chos bsten mdzod/ /ces gsungs pa bzhin no/ /bzhi pa mchod par 'os pa rnams bkur ba ni/ gang gi dpal la mngon brten nas/ /de yi bka' drin nos gyur pa/ /rgyal po gtsug gi nor bu bzhin/ /rtag tu bkur bar mdzod cig dang / /de bzhin nyid la rin chen ltar/ /bzhed dgu ma lus stsol 'gyur zhing / /nyid kyang 'gro ba gzhan dag gi /bkur 'os nyid du 'gyur ba lags/ /zhes bya ba ste/ sa'i bdag po 'gran zla med pa'i skye dgu'i spyi rje gang gi bsod nams kyi dpal la mngon par brten nas mi'i bdag po de'i bka' drin gyis longs spyod 'byor pa dang chab srid rgyas pa dang dbang phyug btsan pa dang mi mthun phyogs kyis mi brdzi ba dang / gnyen 'dab 'phel ba la sogs pa mnos shing thob par 'gyur pa'i rgyal po chen po rtag tu bkur ba dang bka' bzhin byed pa dang thugs 'dun par mdzod cig dang / de ltar byas na rgyal po de ni rgyal bu nyid la yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che ltar bzhed pa'i don thams cad stsol ba dang sbyin par 'gyur la/

rgyal bu nyid kyang rgyal po'i rgyud gzhan dang mkhar gyi rgyal po dang / blon po dang yul dpon la sogs pa 'gro ba gzhan dag gis bkur ba nyid du 'gyur ba lags te sngon skal pa dang po'i dus su rgyal po med par sems can rnams zhing las kyi bya bas nye bar 'tsho ba na 'bru khyer ba la mi mthun par gyur pa'i tshe skye bo rang bzhin bzang po can zhig gis rang gi 'bras bu'i skal ba yang med par sems can thams cad la mnyam par brims pa na de skye bo rnams kyi rgyal por bkur te bka' bzhin du bsgrub pas mang pos bkur ba zhes bya ba'i rgyal po chen por gyur te rgyal rgyud thams cad kyi mes po dang / skye bo thams cad kyi dpal mgon bla na med par gyur pa bzhin no// ༈ //lnga pa dman pa rnams bskyang pa la don dngos dang / de'i phan yon dang / mi mthun phyogs spangs pa dang / bsdus te bstan pa bzhi las dang po ni/ rigs kyi nang na rgan pa dang / /smra ba'i nang na bden smra dang / /gzhung lugs nang na 'thad ldan dang / /brtul bzhugs ldan las gzhan phan can/ /nor gyi nang ni rig pa dang / /ya rab nang na yon tan ldan/ /dman pa'i nang na nyams thag dang / /nyams thag nang na nad pa dang / /chung ma'i nang na rjes 'brang dang / /bu yi nang na rigs 'dzin dang / /gnyen gyi nang na mi bslu dang / /grogs kyi nang na phan 'dogs dang / /bran gyi nang na bsgo ba nyan/ /phan btags nang na drin gzo dang / /gnod bgyis nang na bzod gnas dang / /kun gyi nang na glo bur lhags/ /de dag rnams la de dgongs nas/ /bkur dang bskyangs par mdzod cig dang / /skye bo gzhan yang de rkyen gyis/ /tshul ldan las la 'jug 'gyur lags/ /zhes gsungs te/ de la rigs mnyam pa rnams kyi nang na ni rgan pa kho nar bkur bar 'os te/ sngon byang chub sems dpa'i ri bong dang sri dang spre'u dang glang po che bzhi yid ches pa'i grogs su gyur te/ gang rgan pa de gzhon pa rnams kyis bkur te gus par byas nas grong nas grong dang /

nags nas nags dang / yul nas yul rnams su rgyu ba na de dag gis tshul lugs dge ba spyad pa la brten nas skye bo rnams kyang rgan pa la rim gro byed pa dang 'dzam bu'i gling bde ba dang skyid pa dang 'byor zhing rgyas par gyur par mdo sde skyes pa'i rab las gsungs pa bzhin no/ /smra ba rnams kyi nang na ni bden par smra ba kho na bkur bar 'os te/ sngon rgyal bu bsod nams blo gros zhes bya ba 'dzam bu'i gling gi rgyal srid byed pa na dge slong mang du thos pa'i byang chub sems dpa' snyan pa 'od ces bya bas de bzhin gshegs pa tshogs kyi dbang phyug ces bya ba'i bstan pa 'dzin pa na rgyal bu bsod nams blo gros kyis gus pa dang spro ba dang rab tu dngas pa'i bsam pas bkur bsti cher byas pa na dge slong gzhan dag phrag dog skyes te mtshon cha sna tshogs thogs nas gsod par brtsams pa na/ dge slong des ni spyi bor thal sbyar te/ /tshig smras rgyal ba rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bden pa gang gis chos 'di stong pa na/ /mtshon cha 'di dag me tog man dhar 'gyur/ /ces bden pa'i tshig smras pas nags tshal dang bcas pa'i sa chen po g.yos shing mtshon cha rnams me tog man dha rar gyur te/ rgyal po dang bcas pa'i mchod pa'i gnas su gyur par 'phags pa ting nge 'dzin rgyal po las gsungs so/ /'phags pa klu sgrub kyis kyang / bden pa gang gis 'chi ba 'am/ /rgyal srid nyams par gyur pa'ang de/ /rang gi don la rtag brjod cing / /de las gzhan du smra mi bya/ /ji skad gsungs pa de bzhin du/ /mdzad pa'i brtul zhugs rtag bsten mdzad/ /des ni dpal ldan sa steng du/ /tshad ma yi ni dam par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /gzhung lugs ni bstan bcos te de rnams kyi nang na ni 'thad pa dang rigs pa dang ldan pa mchog dang mnyan par bya ba dang gzung bar bya ba yin la/ de yang mngon gyur brjod byar byed pa la mngon sum gyis mi gnod pa dang /

lkog gyur brjod byar byed pa la rjes dpag gis mi gnod pa dang / shin tu lkog gyur brjod byar byed pa la lung rang nyid mi 'gal ba yin te/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi gsung rab dang / de dang rjes su mthun pa'i bstan bcos rnams yin no/ /de ltar yang / dge slong dag gam mkhas rnams kyis/ /bsregs bcad brdar ba'i gser bzhin du/ /legs par brtags la nga yi bka'/ /blang bar bya yi gus phyir min/ /zhes chos mngon pa'i mdo las gsungs pa dang / sngon rgya gar shar phyogs kyi bram ze las drug la mkhas pa legs par spyod pa nye bar bsags pa mtho btsun grub rje dang bde byed bdag po zhes bya ba spun gnyis mu stegs kyi gzhung lugs dang dbang phyug chen po la mchod par byed pa'i rigs su skyes pa na/ de dag gis bstan bcos thams cad rtogs te bdag cag gi khyim na dbang phyug chen po mchod la/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan bcos ni rigs pa dang ldan pas phul du phyin par gnang na/ de dag gang khyad par du 'phags pa dbang phyug chen po nyid la dri 'o snyam du bsams te/ de dag dbang phyug gang na gnas pa'i ri ke la sha ri la song ste phyin pa na dbang phyug chen po lha mo dbu ma dang bcas pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi slob ma dgra bcom pa lnga brgya la mchod pa dang bsod snyoms dang bsnyen bkur byed pa mthong ste dbang phyug chen pos bram ze spun gnyis la 'di skad du/ gang gi slob ma nyin re bdag cag dga' bas mchod byed yon tan dam pa ldan/ /'jig rten nyes sel yon tan chen po'i mtshan gyi mchog ni rab du grags gyur cing / /shin tu dga' ba'i yid kyis yang dag 'tsho byed tshe na mya ngan 'das 'drar bsam/ /'jig rten gsum gyi bla ma yon tan mnyam med sangs rgyas de ni mkhas pas mchod/ /ces bcom ldan 'das dang de'i bstan bcos nyid mchog tu bshad pa yin no/ /'thad pa dang mi ldan pa ni/

mu stegs byed kyi mchod sbyin gyi tshe phyugs gsod pa dang / 'khrig pa spyod pa dang / me lnga pa dang / mdung rtse gsum pa dang / 'jug ngogs kyi khrus la sogs pa dang / sog po rnams kyis rang gis bsad pa'i sha khrag gis 'tsho ba'i brtul bzhugs la sogs pa ston pa rnams yin te de ni mkhas pa rnams kyis spang bar bya'o/ /brtul zhugs ni dge sbyongs rnams kyi rtags dang tshul te de dang ldan pa'i dge sbyongs rnams kyi nang na ni lus dang srog la sogs pa la 'phangs pa med par gzhan la phan pa byed pa nyid mchog yin te/ sngon 'dzam bu'i gling na rgyal po dpa' bas byin pa zhes bya ba 'dzam bu'i gling gi rgyal po byed de/ de'i tshe kun tu bzang po zhes bya ba'i nags khrod na byang chub sems dpa' mang po rnams kyi nang na dge slong me tog zla mdzes zhes bya ba/ sngon gyi rgyal ba la dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa/ cig tu gzhan la phan par bzhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' chen po zhig 'dug pa des de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa tha mar gyur par rig nas/ bstan pa la bya ba byas la sems can rnams thar pa la dgod par bya'o snyam du bsams nas/ bdag tu 'du shes 'di la gnas nas su/ bstan pa 'di la bsrung par yong mi nus/ /mi bzad phyi dus bde bar gshegs pa yi/ /byang chub bstan pa bkod pa chen po yin/ /gang gis bdag tu 'du shes kun spangs shing / /sems can 'di dag gang zag smra gnas dang / /gzugs dang sgra dang dri dang ro rnams dang / /reg bya spongs pa des ni bstan pa bsrungs/ /bskal pa bye ba gaṅga'i bye snyed du/ /dang ba'i sems kyis zas dang skom rnams dang / /gdugs dang ba dan mar me'i 'phreng ba yis/ /sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig rim gro byas/ /gang gis dam chos rab tu 'jigs pa dang / /bde gshegs bstan pa 'gag par 'gyur pa'i tshe/ /nyin mtshan du yang bslab pa cig spyad pa/ /bsod nams 'di ni de bas khyad du 'phags/

/skyes bu khyu mchog gis ni dam pa'i chos/ /'jig par gyur tshe gang dag btang snyoms pa/ /de yis rgyal bar bkur bsti byas ma yin/ /zhes byang chub sems dpa' rnams la gsungs te nags kyi nang nas phyir byon te/ rgyal po dpa' bas byin gyis rgyal po'i pho brang rin chen ldan par song ste/ sems can bye ba khrag khrig rnams byang chub du bkod de chos kyi gtam gyis dga' bar byas te rgyal po dpa' bas byin gyis bkrongs te sku tshe'i byed pa re shig btang ste byang chub du sangs rgyas pa bzhin no/ /don de dag 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis kyang / gzhan la cig tu phan pa bden/ /mi phan phyir na cig shos min/ /zhes gsungs la/ 'phags pa byams pas kyang / mgo la sems can khur chen khyer ba yi/ /sems can mchog ni dal gyis 'gro mi mdzes/ /bdag gzhan sna tshogs 'ching bas rab bcings pa/ /brtson pa brgya 'gyur du ni bya ba'i rigs/ /zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /nor rnams kyi nang na ni nang rig pa dang / sgra rig pa dang / gtan tshigs rig pa dang / bzo rig pa dang / gso ba rig pa'i gnas rnams mkhyen pa ni mchog yin te/ sngon sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gnyan yod na bzhugs pa na/ rgyal po'i khab na rig pa'i gnas bco brgyad la sbyangs pa'i rgyal po bzo sbyangs gzugs can snying po zhes bya ba rgyal po byed do/ /de'i tshe drang srong gnas len gyi bu zhes bya ba zhig rig pa'i gnas la mkhas te rgyal pos bkur ba dang gser dang nor bu la sogs pa'i nor rnams kyis dga' bar byas pa na lho phyogs na bram ze dkar rgyal zhes bya ba 'ongs nas rig pa'i gnas la phan tshun du rtsod pa na bram ze dkar rgyal gyis mkhan po gnas len gyi bu spobs pa med par byas nas yang rgyal po gzugs can snying pos bram ze dkar rgyal la bkur ba dang / nor rnams kyis dga' bar byas nas dus phyis bram ze dkar rgyal gyis rang gi bu sha ri'i bu la/

mi gang rigs kyis rgan pa dang / /na tshod rgan dang nor gyis rgan/ /de kun thos pas rgan pa yi/ /sgo na don du gnyer bas stod/ /ces smras pa bzhin no/ /'phags pa klu sgrub kyis kyang / shes rab ldan pas blo mi 'phrogs/ /gzhan gyi dring mi 'jog cing brtan/ /bslu bas mi tshugs rgyal po ste/ /de bas shes rab lhur blang bya/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin no/ /ya rab rnams kyi nang na ni sngar smos pa'i rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa nyid mchog yin te/ sngon rgyal po zas gtsang ma'i blon po rnams kyis rgyal bu don thams cad grub pa'i khyim thab kyi ched du shākya lag na be con la shākya'i bu mo sa 'tsho ma blangs pa na/ shākya lag na be con can gyis bdag cag gi lugs kyis ni bu mo rig pa'i gnas la sbyangs pa'i yon tan can la sbyin par bya ba yin na/ don thams cad grub pa ni rang gi khyim du skyid te bar gsos pa rig pa'i gnas dang sgyu rtsal la ma sbyangs pa de la mi sbyin no/ /zhes zer ba rgyal bus gsan te/ rig pa'i gnas rnams la sbyong ba'i tshul bstan te sgyu rtsal drug cu rtsa bzhi la 'gran pa na shākya'i rgyal brgyud gzhan thams cad zil gyis mnan nas rgyal bu don thams cad grub pa nyid thams cad kyi mchog tu gyur pa bzhin no/ /rin po che'i 'phreng ba las kyang / dgra la gnod pa bya na yang / /skyon rnams btang ste yon tan bsten/ /des ni khyod kyi rang phan thob/ /dgra bo yang ni mi dgar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /dman pa rnams kyi nang na ni sdug bsngal gyi nyams thag pa rnams bsod nams kyi zhing du bzang pa yin te/ sngon rgyal po lha'i dbang phyug 'od ces bya ba 'dzam bu'i gling gi rgyal po byed cing / de'i yul na tshong dpon ral pa 'dzin zhes bya ba'i bu khye'u chu 'bebs zhes bya ba gso spyad la sbyangs shing / snying rje dang ldan pa/ nyams thag pa rnams kyi skyabs su gyur pa zhig yod pa des/

'brog dgon pa na rdzing zhig yod pa na nya khri phrag snyed cig chu zad de zas dang skom dang bral nas 'gro ldog byed cing nyams thag la gcan gzan dang bya rnams kyis za ba la thug par mthong ba rnams la snying rje chen po'i bsam pas rgyal po lha'i dbang phyug 'od la glang po che blangs te/ rang gi khyim nas zas dang skom dang chu blangs te nya de dag tshim par byas nas de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen gtsug tor can gyi mtshan brjod cing / rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba'i chos kyi sgra yang bsgrags pas/ nya de dag de'i nub mo tshe'i dus byas nas sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lhar skyes te/ rgyal po lha'i dbang phyug 'od kyi pho brang du me tog gi char babs cing / khye'u chu 'bebs kyi khyim du mu tig gi se mo do bzhi khri byung ngo / /zhes gser 'od dam pa las gsungs pa bzhin no/ /nyams thag pa rnams kyi nang na ni nad pa kho na bsod nams kyi zhing du bzang ste dkon mchog brtsegs pa las/ sngon 'dzam bu gling gi mi rnams la nad kyi rigs rnam pa sna tshogs pa gsor mi rung pa rnams bdag gi sems can rnams nye bar gzir bar gyur pa'i tshe ston pa bcom ldan 'das brgya byin mig bzang zhes bya bar gyur te/ lha'i mig rnam par dag pas gzigs nas/ snying rje chen po'i gzhan gyi dbang du gyur pas/ grong khyer ku ru zhes bya ba dang nye ba na srog chags des pa zhes bya ba'i sems can du brdzus te skyes nas sems can rnams la/ ku ru'i grong khyer nye ba na/ /des pa zhes bya srog chags yod/ /de yi sha la sus zos pa/ /nad rnams kun las thar par 'gyur/ /zhes sgra bsgrags pas/ sems can nad pa rnams ku ru'i grong khyer du lhags te/ srog chags des pa'i sha la zos pas mi zad pa'i sman chen por gyur te sems can rnams nad thams cad las thar par gyur to/ /rgyu de dang rkyen des ston pas lha dang mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa du ma myong par byas nas byang chub tu sangs rgyas pa yin no/

/mngon pa'i mdzod las kyang / 'phags pa min yang pha ma dang / /nad pa dang ni chos smra dang / /skye mtha'i byang chub sems dpa' la/ /yon ni gzhal du med par gsungs/ /zhes 'byung ba yin no/ /chung ma rnams kyi nang na ni rjes su 'brang pa ste bdag po'i snying la babs pa dang rjes su mthun par byed pa dang / phan par 'dod pa dang / dbang du gyur pa ni mchog yin te/ sngon rgyal po thams cad bshes gnyen zhes bya ba'i bu/ rgyal bu thams cad sgrol zhes bya ba'i byang chub sems dpa' chen po thams cad gtong pa la zhugs pa des mi mthun phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal bar byed pa'i glang po rin po che yang dgra zla'i rgyal po la byin nas yab blon po'i tshogs dang bcas pas nags su bskrad pa'i tshe yang rgyan dang shing rta dang bu dang bu mo dang rang nyid za ba'i shing gi lo ma btsos pa dang me tog dang 'bras bu la sogs pa rnams kyang slong pa rnams la byin te/ rgyal bu rang nyid bza' ba dang bgo ba dang btung ba dang mal bstan la sogs pa med par dka' dub kyis gnas par gyur pa'i tshe yang yang snying la 'bab par byed pa dang / rjes su mthun par byed pa dang / phan par 'dod pa dang / dbang du gyur pa'i btsun mo sgyags byin ma zhes bya ba rjes su 'brangs pa bzhin no/ /don de 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis/ /rgyal po bde spyod la gdams pa las/ /sring mo bzhin du rjes mthun gang yin dang / mdza' mo bzhin du snying la babs pa dang / /ma bzhin phan par 'dod dang bran mo bzhin/ /dbang gyur gang yin rigs kyi lha bzhin bkur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /bu rnams kyi nang na ni rang gi ngang tshul dang kun du spyod pa dang gang zhig bya ba'i rigs 'dzin pa ni mchog yin te/ sngon mang pos bkur ba'i rgyal rgyud la go'u ta ma zhes bya ba dang ba ra dwa dza zhes bya ba'i spun gnyis 'byung ngo / /go'u ta ma ni rab tu byung nas drang srong mdog nag po can zhes bya ba'i drung na tshangs par spyod do/

/ba ra dwa dzas ni rgyal srid bzung ngo / /de'i tshe gshed ma ba pad+ma'i rtsa lag ces bya bas gser gyi gdub bu dang bcas pa'i smad tshong ma'i lag pa bregs te khyer nas nags su bros pa na/ mi thar bar rig nas rgyal po gau'u ta ma bsam gtan la gnas pa'i spyil po'i sgo drung du gser gyi gdu bu dang bcas pa'i lag pa dor te/ nags thibs bo'i nang du bzhugs pa na 'dod mi rnams kyis rgyal po gau'u ta ma bzung te/ khrid nas rgyal po ba ra dwa dza'i blon po rnams la gtad do/ /de dag gis ma shes par gsad shing gi rtse mo la skyon no/ /de nas drang srong mdog nag po can gyis tshor te 'ongs nas gtam dris te nyes pa med par shes kyang 'chi ba'i dus byed par rig nas rigs kyi sa bon zhog cig ces smras pa des sa bon thigs pa gnyis phyung ngo / /de bu ram shing gi tshal du phog pa/ nyi mas smin par byas pa las khye'u gnyis byung ste dus phyis rgyal po bha ra dwa dza bu med par sha nas blon po rnams kyis khyi'u de gnyis rgyal por bkos pa las ni/ bu ram shing pa zhes kyang bya/ nyi ma'i gnyen po zhes kyang bya/ go'u ta ma zhes kyang bya ba'i rgyal po byung ste/ de las rgyal po'i rigs du ma byung pa bzhin no/ /gnyen rnams kyi nang na ni mi bslu ba kho na mchog yin te/ sngon grong khyer chen po gnyan yod na/ rgyal po chen po rtsibs kyis 'phur tshangs byin zhes bya ba'i bu rgyal po gsal rgyal zhes bya ba rgyal po byed de/ de'i blon po dam pa ri dwags 'dzin zhes bya ba la mna' ma bu med kyi skyon thams cad spangs pa/ blo dang rig pa shin tu gsal ba/ bya ba thams cad tshul bzhin du sgrub pa zhag pa zhig yod pa de thams cad du mi bslu zhing rgyal po dang blon po dang rang gi khyim thabs thams cad blo gtad pa'i 'os su gyur pas ming yang blon po ri dwags 'dzin gyi ma zhes bya bar btags pa bzhin no/

/grogs rnams kyi nang na ni phan 'dogs pa kho na mchog yin te/ sngon bde spyod dang slob dpon klu sgrub gnyis byis pa gzhon nu'i dus su grogs po byas te/ bde spyod kyis ni rgyal po byed par khas blangs la/ slob dpon gyis ni mchod pa'i gnas byed par khas blangs so/ /dus phyis bde spyod kyis rgyal po byas na slob dpon gyis mchod gnas byas te/ rgyal po'i tshe yang lo drug brgya thub par byin gyis brlabs nas 'jig rten dang chos kyi bya ba ston pa la rin po che'i 'phreng ba dang / bshes pa'i spring yig la sogs pa mdzad de mdor na tshe 'di dang phyi ma'i mngon par 'dod pa thams cad kyis phan btags pa bzhin no/ /bran rnams kyi nang na bsgo ba nyan pa kho na mchog yin te/ rgyal bu don thams cad grub pa ser skya'i grong khyer chen po na shākya'i bu mo sa 'tsho ma la sogs pa bu med drug khri'i dbus na dges par spyod cing bzhugs pa na/ gnas gtsang ma'i lha rnams kyis/ srid gsum mi rtag ston ka'i sprin dang 'dra/ /'gro ba'i skye shi gar la lta dang mtshungs/ /'gro ba'i tshe srog nam mkha'i glog 'dra ste/ /ri gzar 'bab chu'i rgyun bzhin myur mgyogs 'gro/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pas mngon par 'byung par bskul ba na/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' don thams cad grub pa rab tu 'byung par dgongs te/ khyim na gnas pa la skyo bar gyur nas sngon smon lam gyi mthu las byung pa'i bran 'dun pa zhes bya ba la bka' bsgo ba mdzad de/ shing rta'i nang du zhugs nas skyed mos tshal gzigs su byon pa na skye ba dang / na ba dang / shi ba'i sdug bsngal dang / de dag las thar pa'i dge sbyong dag gzigs nas rgyal po zas gtsang ma la sogs pa la rab tu byung par gsungs pa na rgyal bu 'di rab tu ma byung na 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal por 'gyur la de ltar na shākya thams cad 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal srid kyi bde ba spyad du yod kyi rab tu byung na ni ma yin no zhes ser skya'i grong khyer dmag gis bskor te bsrungs so/

/de'i tshe nam phyed kyi dus su byang chub sems dpas 'dun pa la bsgo ba rta'i rgyal po sngags ldan de gtod la khyer la shog cig 'dun pa khyod nga'i g.yog gi bya ba'i tha ma ni do nub kyi 'di yin gyi/ ngas bsgo ba bzhin gyis shig ces gsungs te/ 'dun pas kyang ji ltar bgo ba bzhin du mnyan nas rta'i rgyal po ngang pa sngags ldan chibs te/ 'dun pas 'khrid nas nam mkha' la byon nas slar yang 'dun pa la rta dang rgyan rnams bskur nas rab tu byung ba bzhin no/ /phan btags pa'i skye bo rnams kyi nang na ni drin du gzo ba nyid mchog yin te/ sngon ma ga ta'i rgyal po bzo sbyangs gzugs can snying po zhes bya ba skyed mos tshal du gnyid kyis log pa la dug sbrul gyis brgyugs so/ /de'i tshe rgyal po'i drung na bye'u ka lan dha ka dag yod pas ma bzod de ca co'i sgra chen po byung ngo / /der rgyal po gnyid sad de dug sbrul gyi 'jigs pa las thar ro/ /de nas rgyal po de ni byas pa bzo ba yin pa'i phyir bya ka lan dha ka rnams la mi 'jigs pa byin te/ nga'i yul khongs su bya ka lan dha ka rnams la gnod pa byas na de ngas nyes pa la gtug go zhes bsgrags nas 'od ma'i tshal du 'bru mang po gtor te ka lan dha ka rnams tshims par byas so/ /des na rgyal po'i khab 'od ma'i tshal ka lan dha ka gnas pa na zhes bya ba'i rgyu ni de yin pa bzhin no/ /gnod pa bgyis pa rnams kyi nang na ni lan mi byed par bzod par gnas pa nyid mchog yin te/ de yang bde bar gshegs pa sngon drang srong bzod par smra ba zhes bya bar gyur te/ gcig pu nags khrod dben pa zhig na bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe rgyal po zhig btsun mo'i 'khor dang bcas pa nags su song pa na ji zhig ltar rgyal po gnyid du song pa na btsun mo rnams me tog 'dod pa'i phyir nags su song pa na drang srong de mthong ngo / /de la dad de chos nyan pa na rgyal po gnyis sad de btsun mo rnams btsal ba na drang srong gi drung na 'dug pa mthong nas rgyal po phrag dog gis khengs te/

drang srong khyod kyi ming ci yin zhes dris so/ /bdag bzod par smra ba lags so zhes gsungs pa na khyed de ltar yin min tshad par bya yis zer nas lag pa bcad nas da khyod bzod dam zhes zer ro/ /drang srong gi smras pa bzod do/ /de bzhin du rkang pa dang mig dang mgo bo la sogs pa bcad cing de skad zer kyang bzod do zhes lan du smra ba bzhin no/ /de nyid kyi phyir/ bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang / bzod pa dam pa dka' thub dam pa ni/ /mya ngan 'das pa mchog ces sangs rgyas gsungs/ /rab tu byung ba gzhan la 'tshe ba dang / /gzhan la gnod pa dge sbyong ma yin no/ /zhes gsungs so/ /sngar smos pa rnams sam de las gzhan yang rung ste skye bo kun gyi nang na ni glo bur du lhags pa bkur ba dang mchod par 'os te/ ya rab rnams kyi tshul dang mthun pa'i phyir dang / bsod nams rgyun chags su 'byung bar gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de nyid 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis/ /'dren gnas kun dga' chu lon dang / /rdzing dang chu ra mgron khang dag /mal zas rtswa dang shing ldan par/ /shis rab bzang po bgyid du gsol/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin no/ /de dag rnams la der dgongs nas zhes bya ba ni ji lta ba bzhin du mkhyen nas so/ /bkur bar mdzad de zhes bya ba ni rigs kyi nang na rgan pa dang bden par smra ba dang gzhan la phan pa'i brtul zhugs can dang / ya rab kyi nang na yon tan dang ldan pa rnams so/ /lhag ma rnams ni bskyang par mdzod cig ces sbyar ro/ /de ltar rgyal bu nyid de ltar mdzad na yum dang sras dang blon po dang yul 'bangs kyi skye bo gzhan yang rgyal bu nyid kyis de ltar mdzad pa'i rkyen gyis sngar smos pa'i ngang tshul dang ldan pa'i las la 'jug par 'gyur ba lags so zhes sbyar bar bya te/ rin po che'i 'phreng ba las/ chos las rgyal srid bde ba dang / /phyogs rnams kun tu grags pa yis/ /bla re rgya chen 'byung 'gyur zhing /

/blon po rnams kyang kun du 'dud/ /zhes gsungs so/ /da ni gzhan bskyangs pa'i phan yon ni/ nya pa dang ni shan pa sogs/ /gzhan la 'tshe ba de dag gis/ /bdag gi don yang mi 'grub na/ /gzhan don smos kyang ci zhig 'tshal/ /slob ma rgyal sras rgyal ba rnams/ /gzhan gyi don gyi khyad par gyis/ /tha ma 'bring dang mchog gi tshul/ /brnyes pa lkog gyur lags mod kyang / /chung ngu 'bring dang mang po la/ /nye bar phan pa don gnyer bas/ /chung ngu 'bring dang chen po yi/ /gtso bor gyur pa ma gzigs sam/ /de slad lus can ji snyed la/ /khyed thugs brtse bar rigs lags na/ /nyid la brten pa'i skye bo la/ /brtse bar rigs pa smos ci 'tshal/ /zhes gsungs te/ nya pa dang shan pa dang gshed ma ba dang btson srung la sogs pa gzhan la 'tshe ba dang gnod pa'i bya bas nye bar 'tshe ba de dag gis ni bdag gi tshe 'di yi don 'byor pa dang skyid pa dang rgyags pa dang / phyi ma'i don mtho ris dang thar pa cung zad kyang bsgrub par mi nus na gzhan gyi don lta smos kyang ci zhig 'tshal te/ de bas na gzhan la 'tshe ba kun tu spang par bgyi zhing / gzhan gyi don la brtson par bgyi ste slob ma nyan thos rnams gzhan gyi don shas chung pas spangs pa dang rtogs pa dang yon tan chung pa'i 'phags pa dang / rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa' rnams sems can gzhan gyi don byed pa shas che bas spangs pa dang rtogs pa dang yon tan 'bring gi 'phags pa dang / rgyal ba sangs rgyas rnams gzhan gyi don 'ba' zhig spyod cing rgya che bas spangs pa dang rtogs pa dang yon tan thams cad phun sum tshogs pa'i 'phags pa'i mchog brnyes pa ni shin du lkog du gyur pa yin pas lung las rtogs par bya ba yin mod kyi/ rang gi bza' 'khor chung ngu ste nyung ngu la phan pa don du gnyer ba las ni bza' 'khor gyi dpon dang / 'bring yul 'khor la phan pa don du gnyer ba las ni yul gyi dpon dang /

skye bo mang po la phan pa don du gnyer bas ni phyogs thams cad kyi rgyal po ste/ de ltar na chung pa dang 'bring po chen por gyur pa ni thams cad kyis mngon sum du gzigs pa bzhin no/ /de ltar yang 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis/ yan lag thams cad mi gtsang pas/ bkus pa'i sbrul dug 'dzag pa ltar/ /gang la brten nas lus can rnams/ /skrag par 'gyur ba de re ngan/ /char sprin chen po langs pa na/ /zhing pa rnams ni ji lta bar/ /gang la brten nas lus can rnams/ /dga' bar 'gyur ba de re bzang / /zhes gsungs so/ /rgyu mtshan de'i slad du lus can gyi skye bo ma lus pa la rgyal bu khyod kyi thugs brtse bar rigs na rgyal bu nyid la rten pa'i skye bo blon po dang sku srung pa dang phyag tshangs pa dang bya ba la bskos pa dang / yul 'bangs dang de dag la brten pa'i dud 'gro rnams la brtse bar rigs pa smos ci 'tshal te/ gang la blo gtad pa slu ba ni skye bo ngan pa'i mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir te/ dom gyi skyes pa'i rab las/ sngon nags khrod dben pa zhig na byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la gnas pa'i dom zhig bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe yul 'khor gyi skye bo shing thu ba zhig nags su zhugs pa na char drag po zhag mang po'i bar du babs pas skye bo de rengs par byas nas grong khyer du bgrod ma nus par brag phug zhig tu phyin pa na dom de gnas pa mthong nas kye ma srog dang bral lo snyam du 'jigs nas yid chad pa na dom gyis kyang ma 'jigs shig ngas khyod la gnod pa mi byed do zhes zer te/ dom gyis 'dabs su bzhag nas lus rengs pa zhi bar byas/ shing thog rnams byin nas 'grangs par byas te da khyod grong khyer du 'gro ba'i dus la babs kyi/ nga'i sha 'dod pa'i rngon pa dag la khyod kyis ma smra zhig ces bya ste/ skye bo de phyir song pa dang rngon pa dang 'phrad de de'i sna khrid byas nas dom la mdzub mo btsugs pa na mdzub mo sa la lhung pa bzhin no/
